	<TD class="tr2 td299"><P class="p942 ft85">Artikel 44</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td50"><P class="p17 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr26 td299"><P class="p942 ft27">Information under verkställigheten i Estland</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr26 td50"><P class="p17 ft2">Bilaga 1</P></TD>
</TR>
</TABLE>
<P class="p771 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">1.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">Estlands kriminalvårdsmyndighet ska omedelbart rapportera alla allvarliga incidenter som avser anstaltens säkerhet till Kriminalvården. Estlands kriminalvårdsmyndighet ska också omedelbart rapportera all mediebevakning av anstalten till Kriminalvården.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p808 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">2.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">Estlands kriminalvårdsmyndighet ska till Kriminalvården regelbundet rapportera om varje väckt talan som avser intagna under verkställighet av ett svenskt fängelsestraff i anstalten.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p808 ft64"><SPAN class="ft2">3.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft115">Estlands kriminalvårdsmyndighet ska informera Kriminalvården om framställningar om rättsligt samarbete från tredjeländer som avser intagna.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p771 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">4.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">Estlands kriminalvårdsmyndighet ska tillhandahålla Kriminalvården kopior av klagomål från intagna i frågor där Estlands lagar och andra författningar är tillämpliga enligt artikel 6.1.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p772 ft64"><SPAN class="ft2">5.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft115">Estlands kriminalvårdsmyndighet ska på Kriminalvårdens begäran lämna annan information om verkställigheten i Estland.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p943 ft2">297</P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_298">

	<TD class="tr2 td290"><P class="p556 ft2">verkställigheten i anstalten som krävs för den fortsatta verkställigheten i</P></TD>

<P class="p944 ft2">298</P>
</DIV>

	<TD class="tr2 td50"><P class="p17 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185</P></TD>

	<TD class="tr26 td90"><P class="p867 ft27">Konfidentialitet</P></TD>

	<TD class="tr20 td90"><P class="p867 ft2">Parterna ska behandla all information som utbyts inom ramen för detta</P></TD>

</TR>

	<TD class="tr2 td50"><P class="p17 ft6"> </P></TD>

<P class="p945 ft2">299</P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_300">

	<TD class="tr2 td300"><P class="p556 ft19">DEL X</P></TD>

	<TD class="tr4 td118"><P class="p17 ft2">Bilaga 1</P></TD>
	<TD rowspan=2 class="tr2 td300"><P class="p787 ft19">IMMUNITET OCH PRIVILEGIER M.M.</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr25 td118"><P class="p17 ft58"> </P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr20 td118"><P class="p17 ft6"> </P></TD>
	<TD class="tr20 td300"><P class="p556 ft19">Artikel 47</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td118"><P class="p17 ft6"> </P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td300"><P class="p556 ft27">Tillsyn över, utredningar om, klagomål från och talan som väcks av</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td118"><P class="p17 ft6"> </P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td300"><P class="p787 ft27">intagna</P></TD>
</TR>
</TABLE>
<P class="p946 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">1.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">Tillsyn över och genomförande av verkställigheten av svenska straff regleras i enlighet med artikel 6 av Estlands lagar och andra författningar vad gäller detta avtal och samarbetsavtalet.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p946 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">2.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">Kriminalvården ska ha rätt att övervaka att straff verkställs korrekt och ska i det avseendet ha den tillgång som avses i artiklarna 7 och 24.7 i detta avtal.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p946 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">3.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">Internationella organ som Europeiska kommittén till förhindrande av tortyr och omänsklig eller förnedrande behandling eller bestraffning får göra anmälda och oanmälda besök i anstalten och vad gäller transport enligt artikel 24 och överföring och behandling enligt artikel 41. Estland ska i största möjliga mån ge dem tillgång till information och låta dem ha samtal med intagna.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p789 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">4.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">Estlands berörda myndigheter får i tillämpliga fall och i enlighet med detta avtal och de myndigheternas mandat göra utredningar med koppling till Estlands lagar och andra författningar.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p817 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">5.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">Estländska advokater och andra rättsliga ombud kan få tillstånd att tillhandahålla juridiska tjänster i anstalten i enlighet med Estlands lagar och andra författningar. Estlands kriminalvårdsmyndighet ska fatta beslut om sådant tillstånd i enlighet med Estlands lagar och andra författningar.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p946 ft117"><SPAN class="ft2">6.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft116">Andra advokater och rättsliga ombud än sådana som avses i punkt 5 kan, liksom </SPAN><NOBR>icke-statliga</NOBR> organisationer som tillhandahåller juridiska tjänster, få tillstånd att tillhandahålla juridiska tjänster i anstalten eller genom kontakt med en intagen via ljudöverföring eller ljud- och bildöverföring. Kriminalvården ska fatta beslut om sådant tillstånd i enlighet med Sveriges lagar och andra författningar.</P>
<P class="p947 ft64"><SPAN class="ft2">7.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft115">Besök av en advokat som biträder en intagen i ett rättsligt ärende får endast övervakas om advokaten eller den intagne begär det.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p948 ft2">300</P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_301">


<TABLE cellpadding=0 cellspacing=0 class="t104">
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td278"><P class="p949 ft85">Artikel 48</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td50"><P class="p17 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr26 td278"><P class="p949 ft27">Svensk personals immunitet</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr26 td50"><P class="p17 ft2">Bilaga 1</P></TD>
</TR>
</TABLE>
<P class="p771 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">1.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">Den svenska personalen åtnjuter immunitet vad avser utövandet av estländsk domsrätt med avseende på åtgärder de vidtar under utövandet av sin tjänst.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p832 ft117"><SPAN class="ft2">2.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft116">Den immunitet som föreskrivs i punkt 1 beviljas för en korrekt tillämpning av detta avtal och inte i den svenska personalens personliga intresse. Sverige ska på eget initiativ eller på Estlands begäran häva den svenska personalens immunitet i alla eventuella fall där ett underlåtande att göra det skulle hindra rättvisans gång och där immuniteten kan hävas utan men för det ändamål för vilket den beviljats.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p834 ft64"><SPAN class="ft2">3.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft115">Den immunitet som föreskrivs i punkt 1 undantar inte den svenska personalen från svensk domsrätt.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p771 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">4.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">Alla Sveriges akter, handlingar och andra datamedier som den svenska personalen under utövandet av sin tjänst har i sin besittning ska, var de än finns, vara okränkbara. Estland får begära tillgång till relevanta handlingar.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p846 ft64"><SPAN class="ft2">5.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft115">Immunitet vad avser egendom, tillgångar och andra relevanta föremål ska anges närmare i samarbetsavtalet.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p825 ft64"><SPAN class="ft2">6.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft115">Den svenska personalen ska vara befriad från beskattning i Estland av löner och liknande ersättningar som utbetalas av Kriminalvården.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p950 ft2">301</P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_302">


<TABLE cellpadding=0 cellspacing=0 class="t105">
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td301"><P class="p17 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td302"><P class="p556 ft19">Artikel 49</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr4 td301"><P class="p17 ft2">Bilaga 1</P></TD>
	<TD rowspan=2 class="tr2 td302"><P class="p556 ft27">Intagnas inkomstskatt</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr25 td301"><P class="p17 ft58"> </P></TD>
</TR>
</TABLE>
<P class="p789 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">1.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">Vid bestämning av en intagens skattskyldighet i Estland till följd av hemvist, bosättning eller något annat liknande kriterium ska tid som den intagne tillbringat på estländskt territorium för att avtjäna ett svensk straff inte anses som tid som tillbringats i Estland.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p873 ft64"><SPAN class="ft2">2.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft115">Punkt 1 ska endast gälla om den intagne när han inleder avtjänandet av det svenska straffet</SPAN></P>
<P class="p816 ft64"><SPAN class="ft2">a)</SPAN><SPAN class="ft113">är skattskyldig i Sverige till följd av hemvist, bosättning eller något annat liknande kriterium, och</SPAN></P>
<P class="p883 ft2"><SPAN class="ft2">b)</SPAN><SPAN class="ft20">inte är skattskyldig i Estland av något sådant skäl.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p843 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">3.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">Sådan ersättning som avses i artikel 32 ska vara befriad från beskattning i Estland.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p951 ft2">302</P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_303">


<DIV id="id_1">
<DIV id="id_1_1">
<P class="p952 ft19">DEL XI</P>
<P class="p953 ft19">KOSTNADER</P>
<P class="p954 ft19">Artikel 50</P>
<P class="p955 ft3">Efter ikraftträdande</P>
<P class="p956 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">1.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">Estland kommer att stå för kostnaderna för att anpassa, förbereda och utrusta anstalten i enlighet med vad som krävs utifrån standarderna och de rättsliga kraven i detta avtal.</SPAN></P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="id_1_2">
<P class="p14 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185 Bilaga 1</P>
</DIV>
</DIV>
<DIV id="id_2">
<P class="p957 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">2.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">De anpassningar som krävs ska bestämmas i dialog mellan Kriminalvården och Estlands kriminalvårdsmyndighet.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p826 ft2">303</P>
</DIV>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_304">


<TABLE cellpadding=0 cellspacing=0 class="t106">
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td303"><P class="p17 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td177"><P class="p581 ft19">Artikel 51</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr4 td303"><P class="p17 ft2">Bilaga 1</P></TD>
	<TD rowspan=2 class="tr2 td177"><P class="p556 ft27">Vid full beläggning</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr25 td303"><P class="p17 ft58"> </P></TD>
</TR>
</TABLE>
<P class="p836 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">1.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">Estland ska garantera att så många anstaltsplatser som anges i artikel 13.1 senast tolv (12) månader efter att detta avtal trätt i kraft är tillgängliga i sin helhet.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p692 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">2.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">Efter den övergångsperiod som avses i artikel 52 ska Sverige sex månader i förväg och i två delbetalningar per år, var och en motsvarande</SPAN></P>
<P class="p958 ft64">50 procent av den gällande årsavgiften, betala en fast årsavgift om 30 600 000 euro för tillgänglig kapacitet för 300 intagna.</P>
<P class="p789 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">3.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">Utnyttjad kapacitet utöver den som det betalas för i enlighet med punkt 2 ska beräknas månadsvis och betalas av Sverige i efterskott, till en kostnad av 8 500 euro per månad och intagen.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p959 ft2">304</P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_305">

</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr26 td244"><P class="p960 ft27">Övergångsperiod</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr26 td50"><P class="p17 ft2">Bilaga 1</P></TD>
</TR>

<P class="p771 ft117"><SPAN class="ft2">1.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft116">Det sammanlagda antalet enkelceller som anges i artikel 13.1 ska ställas till förfogande gradvis under en övergångsperiod på tolv (12) månader räknat från det att detta avtal träder i kraft. Övergångsperioden ska delas upp i fyra kvartal och kapaciteten ska ställas till förfogande i enlighet med punkterna </SPAN><NOBR>2–5.</NOBR></P>
<P class="p833 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">2.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">I början av det första kvartalet efter att detta avtal träder i kraft ska Estland garantera att 25 procent av den kapacitet som avses i punkt 1 (100 celler) står till förfogande.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p832 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">3.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">I början av det andra kvartalet efter att detta avtal träder i kraft ska Estland garantera att 50 procent av den kapacitet som avses i punkt 1 (200 celler) står till förfogande.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p808 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">4.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">I början av det tredje kvartalet efter att detta avtal träder i kraft ska Estland garantera att 75 procent av den kapacitet som avses i punkt 1 (300 celler) står till förfogande.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p832 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">5.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">I början av det fjärde kvartalet efter att detta avtal träder i kraft ska Estland garantera att 100 procent av den kapacitet som avses i punkt 1 (400 celler) står till förfogande.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p808 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">6.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">Den fasta avgiften för övergångsperioden ska vara 22 950 000 euro och betalas i förskott av Sverige senast 2 månader efter att detta avtal träder i kraft.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p808 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">7.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">I det fjärde kvartal som avses i punkt 5 ska kostnaden för eventuella utnyttjade celler utöver de 300 celler som avses i punkt 4 beräknas månadsvis och betalas i efterskott till en kostnad av 8 500 euro per intagen och månad.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p961 ft2">305</P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_306">

	<TD class="tr20 td116"><P class="p581 ft2">Sverige ska ersätta kostnader förbundna med en intagens oförutsedda</P></TD>

	<TD class="tr2 td116"><P class="p581 ft2">brott. Detta gäller för kostnader som uppstår under perioden fram till dess</P></TD>

	<TD class="tr26 td111"><P class="p17 ft6"> </P></TD>
	<TD class="tr26 td116"><P class="p556 ft2">att asylansökan eller brottsutredningen blir föremål för ett lagakraftvunnet</P></TD>

	<TD class="tr2 td111"><P class="p17 ft6"> </P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td116"><P class="p17 ft2">avgörande från en estländsk myndighet.</P></TD>

<P class="p924 ft2">306</P>
</DIV>

<P class="p945 ft2">307</P>
</DIV>

	<TD class="tr4 td304"><P class="p17 ft2">Bilaga 1</P></TD>
	<TD rowspan=2 class="tr2 td122"><P class="p556 ft19">SLUTBESTÄMMELSER</P></TD>

	<TD class="tr25 td304"><P class="p17 ft58"> </P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr20 td304"><P class="p17 ft6"> </P></TD>
	<TD class="tr20 td122"><P class="p556 ft19">Artikel 55</P></TD>

<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td304"><P class="p17 ft6"> </P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td122"><P class="p556 ft27">Ikraftträdande och giltighetstid</P></TD>
</TR>

<P class="p789 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">1.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">Detta avtal ska ratificeras av parterna. Parterna ska på diplomatisk väg skriftligen meddela varandra när de nationella rättsliga förfaranden som krävs för att detta avtal ska träda i kraft är slutförda. Detta avtal träder i kraft den trettionde dagen efter att det sista meddelandet mottagits.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p311 ft2"><SPAN class="ft2">2.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft23">Detta avtal gäller i fem (5) år efter att det trätt i kraft.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p946 ft117"><SPAN class="ft2">3.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft116">Detta avtals giltighetstid ska förlängas automatiskt med ytterligare perioder på tre (3) år i taget såvida inte någon av parterna meddelar den andra parten sin avsikt att säga upp detta avtal. Ett sådant meddelande ska göras senast tolv (12) månader före</SPAN></P>
<P class="p962 ft2"><SPAN class="ft2">a)</SPAN><SPAN class="ft20">utgången av den period som avses i punkt 2, eller</SPAN></P>
<P class="p963 ft64"><SPAN class="ft2">b)</SPAN><SPAN class="ft113">utgången av en sådan ytterligare period som avses i den här punkten.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p964 ft2">308</P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_309">


<TABLE cellpadding=0 cellspacing=0 class="t76">
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td282"><P class="p839 ft85">Artikel 56</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td50"><P class="p17 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr26 td282"><P class="p839 ft27">Ansvar</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr26 td50"><P class="p17 ft2">Bilaga 1</P></TD>
</TR>
</TABLE>
<P class="p771 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">1.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">Om en part underlåter att följa detta avtal och fullgöra skyldigheter som följer av det ska den parten ersätta den andra parten för all skada som detta medför.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p832 ft117"><SPAN class="ft2">2.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft116">Om en part för att fullgöra sina skyldigheter enligt detta avtal och skyldigheter som följer av det anlitar en tredje part ska parten vara ansvarsskyldig för den tredje partens handlingar, underlåtelser eller andra uppträdande på samma sätt som för partens egna.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p931 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">3.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">Estland ska svara för varje personskada som en intagen vållas på grund av estländsk personals fel eller försummelse. Detta innefattar även ersättning för kränkningar av den intagnes personliga integritet.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p832 ft117"><SPAN class="ft2">4.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft116">Estland ska svara för varje skada, kostnad eller förlust för anstalten och dess fasta och lösa egendom som en intagen vållat genom normal användning eller på annat sätt. Detsamma gäller för all skada som en intagen vållat den estländska personalen.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p833 ft117"><SPAN class="ft2">5.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft116">Om en intagen rymmer ska Estland svara för varje skada, kostnad eller förlust som den intagne vållar. Detsamma gäller för varje skada, kostnad eller förlust som den intagne vållar under beviljade tillfälliga vistelser utanför anstalten som verkställs på estländskt territorium.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p927 ft64"><SPAN class="ft2">6.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft115">Trots vad som sägs ovan konstaterar parterna att en intagen enligt estländsk lag kan hållas personligt ansvarsskyldig för avsiktlig skada.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p965 ft2">309</P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_310">


<TABLE cellpadding=0 cellspacing=0 class="t109">
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td241"><P class="p17 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td246"><P class="p581 ft19">Artikel 57</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr4 td241"><P class="p17 ft2">Bilaga 1</P></TD>
	<TD rowspan=2 class="tr2 td246"><P class="p556 ft3">Force majeure</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr25 td241"><P class="p17 ft58"> </P></TD>
</TR>
</TABLE>
<P class="p836 ft117"><SPAN class="ft2">1.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft116">Om det inträffar en händelse som gör att force majeure föreligger, och detta förhindrar att detta avtal helt eller delvis fullgörs, ska den berörda parten snarast möjligt skriftligen underrätta den andra parten om de berörda sakförhållandena. Efter att underrättelsen mottagits ska parterna inleda samtal för att fastställa huruvida detta avtal och skyldigheter som följer av det på godtagbara villkor kan ändras.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p724 ft117"><SPAN class="ft2">2.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft116">En händelse som gör att force majeure föreligger innebär alla omständigheter som ligger utanför den berörda partens rimliga kontroll, t.ex. naturkatastrof, krig, upplopp, kravaller, brand, explosion, terrorism, sabotage, strejk, lockout, störning på arbetsmarknaden, olyckshändelse, epidemi, pandemi, sammanbrott av allmännyttiga tjänster, order eller dekret av domstol eller extraordinär handling från tredje parts sida.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p966 ft2">310</P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_311">


<TABLE cellpadding=0 cellspacing=0 class="t110">
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td305"><P class="p967 ft85">Artikel 58</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td50"><P class="p17 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr26 td305"><P class="p967 ft27">Samråd och tvistlösning</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr26 td50"><P class="p17 ft2">Bilaga 1</P></TD>
</TR>
</TABLE>
<P class="p821 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">1.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">Parterna ska vidta de åtgärder som krävs för att säkerställa fullständig efterlevnad av detta avtal. Om Kriminalvården konstaterar att Estland brustit i genomförandet av detta avtal och detta meddelats Estlands kriminalvårdsmyndighet ska det hanteras omedelbart.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p879 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">2.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">Tvister som uppstår till följd av efterlevnaden av detta avtal ska i första hand lösas genom samråd mellan Kriminalvården och Estlands kriminalvårdsmyndighet.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p341 ft2"><SPAN class="ft2">3.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft23">Om en tvist inte kan lösas i enlighet med punkt 2 ska parterna vid behov</SPAN></P>
<P class="p968 ft117">samråda med varandra om tillämpningen av avtalet. Meningsskiljaktigheter eller tvister mellan parterna om tolkningen eller tillämpningen av detta avtal ska lösas genom förhandlingar mellan parterna.</P>
<P class="p969 ft2">311</P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_312">


<TABLE cellpadding=0 cellspacing=0 class="t99">
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td111"><P class="p17 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td116"><P class="p581 ft19">Artikel 59</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr4 td111"><P class="p17 ft2">Bilaga 1</P></TD>
	<TD rowspan=2 class="tr2 td116"><P class="p581 ft27">Suspension</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr25 td111"><P class="p17 ft58"> </P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr20 td111"><P class="p17 ft6"> </P></TD>
	<TD class="tr20 td116"><P class="p556 ft2">Detta avtal får när som helst med parternas ömsesidiga samtycke helt eller</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td111"><P class="p17 ft6"> </P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td116"><P class="p581 ft2">delvis tillfälligt suspenderas. Vardera parten får när som helst på</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td111"><P class="p17 ft6"> </P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td116"><P class="p581 ft2">diplomatisk väg föreslå att detta avtal suspenderas. En sådan suspension</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr26 td111"><P class="p17 ft6"> </P></TD>
	<TD class="tr26 td116"><P class="p17 ft2">ska gälla i enlighet med vad parterna kommer överens om.</P></TD>
</TR>
</TABLE>
<P class="p944 ft2">312</P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_313">


<TABLE cellpadding=0 cellspacing=0 class="t6">
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td90"><P class="p867 ft85">Artikel 60</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td50"><P class="p17 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr26 td90"><P class="p970 ft27">Ändringar</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr26 td50"><P class="p17 ft2">Bilaga 1</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr20 td90"><P class="p867 ft2">Detta avtal får ändras med parternas ömsesidiga samtycke. Vardera parten</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr20 td50"><P class="p17 ft6"> </P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td90"><P class="p867 ft2">får när som helst på diplomatisk väg föreslå ändringar av detta avtal.</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td50"><P class="p17 ft6"> </P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td90"><P class="p17 ft2">Sådana ändringar träder i kraft i enlighet med artikel 55.1.</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td50"><P class="p17 ft6"> </P></TD>
</TR>
</TABLE>
<P class="p868 ft2">313</P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_314">

	<TD class="tr2 td306"><P class="p17 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td101"><P class="p581 ft19">Artikel 61</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr4 td306"><P class="p17 ft2">Bilaga 1</P></TD>
	<TD rowspan=2 class="tr2 td101"><P class="p556 ft27">Uppsägning</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr25 td306"><P class="p17 ft58"> </P></TD>
</TR>
</TABLE>
<P class="p789 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">1.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">Utan hinder av artikel 55 får detta avtal när som helst sägas upp av någon av parterna genom skriftligt meddelande till den andra parten på diplomatisk väg. Om detta avtal sägs upp ska det upphöra att gälla tolv (12) månader efter att meddelandet mottagits.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p946 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">2.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">Efter att parterna mottagit ett meddelande om uppsägning av detta avtal ska de omedelbart inleda samråd för att fastställa villkoren för att verkställigheten av svenska straff i anstalten ska upphöra.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p817 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">3.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">Att detta avtal sägs upp ska inte påverka rättigheter och skyldigheter som följer av verkställandet av detta avtal och samarbetsavtalet innan avtalet sades upp.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p692 ft117"><SPAN class="ft2">4.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft116">Om detta avtal sägs upp ska personuppgifter som Estland mottagit från Sverige, om Sverige anser det nödvändigt, fortsätta att behandlas i enlighet med de regler som avses i artikel 3.2 eller annars återlämnas eller raderas i enlighet med instruktioner från Kriminalvården.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p881 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">5.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">När detta avtal sägs upp ska parterna säkerställa att verkställigheten av svenska straff i anstalten upphör och att inga intagna och ingen egendom som Sverige fört in i anstalten finns kvar i anstalten.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p946 ft64"><SPAN class="ft108">Till bekräftelse härav </SPAN>har undertecknade, därtill vederbörligen bemyndigade av sina respektive regeringar, undertecknat detta avtal.</P>
<P class="p971 ft109"><SPAN class="ft122">Utfärdat </SPAN>i Stockholm den 18 juni 2025 i två exemplar på svenska, estniska och engelska språken, vilka alla texter är lika giltiga. Vid skiljaktiga tolkningar ska den engelska texten ha företräde.</P>

<DIV id="id_1">
<P class="p1008 ft109">The Government of the Kingdom of Sweden and the Government of the Republic of Estonia (hereinafter referred to collectively as “the Parties” and individually as a “Party”);</P>
<P class="p1009 ft109">Considering the close and longstanding cooperation and relationship between the Kingdom of Sweden and the Republic of Estonia;</P>
<P class="p1010 ft64">Recognising the shared commitment to common fundamental values, and wishing to further develop cooperation;</P>
<P class="p1011 ft117">Desiring to strengthen mutual ties and cooperation within the <NOBR>Nordic-Baltic</NOBR> cooperation formats and the North Atlantic Treaty Organization, as well as in the area of prison service and the promotion of rule of law, democracy and human rights;</P>
<P class="p1012 ft64">Acknowledging that the Swedish Prison and Probation Service is facing challenges relating to available correctional infrastructure;</P>
<P class="p1013 ft64">Noting that the principles of free consent, good faith and the <SPAN class="ft108">pacta sunt servanda </SPAN>rule are universally recognised;</P>
<P class="p1014 ft109">Stressing that this Agreement shall be implemented with full respect for human rights, as laid down in international human rights conventions to which the Parties are Contracting Parties; and</P>
<P class="p1015 ft64">Desiring to afford each other the widest measure of mutual assistance;</P>
<P class="p280 ft2">Have agreed as follows:</P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="id_2">
<P class="p63 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185 Bilaga 2</P>
<P class="p753 ft2">321</P>
</DIV>
</DIV>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_322">


<DIV>
<DIV id="id_1">
<P class="p801 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185 Bilaga 2</P>
<P class="p755 ft2">322</P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="id_2">
<P class="p952 ft19">PART I</P>
<P class="p407 ft19">GENERAL PROVISIONS</P>
<P class="p765 ft19">Article 1</P>
<P class="p1016 ft3">Use of terms</P>
<P class="p280 ft2">For the purposes of this Agreement:</P>
<P class="p65 ft2">a. “Sweden” means: the Kingdom of Sweden;</P>
<P class="p65 ft2">b. “Estonia” means: the Republic of Estonia;</P>
<P class="p280 ft2">c. “Prison” means: the Tartu prison located in Tartu, Estonia;</P>
<P class="p934 ft64">d. “Swedish staff” means: staff appointed by the Swedish Prison and Probation Service;</P>
<P class="p280 ft2">e. “Estonian staff” means: staff appointed by Estonian authorities;</P>
<P class="p934 ft109">f. “Swedish sentence” means: a sentence of imprisonment imposed by a final and in Sweden enforceable decision of a Swedish court;</P>
<P class="p1017 ft64">g. “Prisoner” means: a person upon whom a Swedish sentence of imprisonment is imposed and who is transferred to Estonia;</P>
<P class="p768 ft64">h. “Prison Health Unit” means: a health service provider located in the Prison;</P>
<P class="p768 ft117">i. “Memorandum of Cooperation” means: an agreement within the scope of this Agreement between the Swedish Prison and Probation Service and the Estonian Ministry of Justice and Digital Affairs that sets forth further terms and conditions under which the Prison shall be used for the purpose of enforcement of Swedish sentences;</P>
<P class="p1018 ft109">j. “European Prison Rules” means: Recommendation <NOBR>Rec(2006)2-rev</NOBR> of the Committee of Ministers to member states on the European Prison Rules;</P>
<P class="p1019 ft117">k. “CPT Standards” means: the standards developed by the European Committee for the Prevention of Torture and Inhuman or Degrading Treatment or Punishment (CPT) that are relevant in the context of imprisonment.</P>
</DIV>
</DIV>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_323">


<TABLE cellpadding=0 cellspacing=0 class="t117">
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td311"><P class="p1020 ft19">Article 2</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td50"><P class="p17 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr26 td311"><P class="p1020 ft27">Purposes and scope</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr26 td50"><P class="p17 ft2">Bilaga 2</P></TD>
</TR>
</TABLE>
<P class="p771 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">1.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">This Agreement sets forth the framework for cooperation between Sweden and Estonia on the enforcement of Swedish sentences in Estonia as well as the procedure, rights and duties of the Parties.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p832 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">2.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">This Agreement constitutes a legally binding instrument under international law and is governed by the Vienna Convention on the Law of Treaties (1969).</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1021 ft2">323</P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_324">


<DIV id="id_1">
<DIV id="id_1_1">
<P class="p14 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185 Bilaga 2</P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="id_1_2">
<P class="p774 ft19">Article 3</P>
<P class="p1022 ft3">Compliance with other international instruments</P>
<P class="p776 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">1.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">All activities under this Agreement shall be conducted with full respect for the Parties’ rights and legal obligations under international law, including but not limited to:</SPAN></P>
<P class="p777 ft2"><SPAN class="ft2">a.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft20">European Union law;</SPAN></P>
<P class="p936 ft2"><SPAN class="ft2">b.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft20">the International Covenant on Civil and Political Rights;</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1023 ft64"><SPAN class="ft2">c.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft113">the Convention against Torture and Other Cruel, Inhuman or Degrading Treatment or Punishment and its Optional Protocol;</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1024 ft64"><SPAN class="ft2">d.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft115">the European Convention on Human Rights and its Protocol No. 1; and</SPAN></P>
<P class="p778 ft64"><SPAN class="ft2">e.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft113">the Convention Relating to the Status of Refugees and its 1967 Protocol.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p768 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">2.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">The processing of personal data under this Agreement shall be carried out in accordance with Regulation (EU) 2016/679 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 27 April 2016 on the protection of natural persons with regard to the processing of personal data and on the free movement of such data, and repealing Directive 95/46/EC (General Data Protection Regulation) and in accordance with Directive (EU) 2016/680 of the European Parliament and of the Council of 27 April 2016 on the protection of natural persons with regard to the processing of personal data by competent authorities for the purposes of the prevention, investigation, detection or prosecution of criminal offences or the execution of criminal penalties, and on the free movement of such data, and repealing Council Framework Decision 2008/977/JHA.</SPAN></P>
</DIV>
</DIV>
<DIV id="id_2">
<P class="p14 ft2">324</P>
</DIV>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_325">


<TABLE cellpadding=0 cellspacing=0 class="t66">
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td272"><P class="p770 ft19">Article 4</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td50"><P class="p17 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr26 td272"><P class="p770 ft27">Memorandum of Cooperation</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr26 td50"><P class="p17 ft2">Bilaga 2</P></TD>
</TR>
</TABLE>
<P class="p771 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">1.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">With a view to the implementation and practical application of this Agreement, the Swedish Prison and Probation Service and the Estonian Ministry of Justice and Digital Affairs shall draft a Memorandum of Cooperation regarding, for instance, the functioning of the Prison, the staff, the facilities, the transport of Prisoners and other tasks that may be carried out by the Swedish Prison and Probation Service or the Estonian Prison and Probation Service.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1025 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">2.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">The Memorandum of Cooperation shall be agreed upon by the Swedish Prison and Probation Service and the Estonian Ministry of Justice and Digital Affairs.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p832 ft117"><SPAN class="ft2">3.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft116">The Swedish Prison and Probation Service and the Estonian Ministry of Justice and Digital Affairs may enter into additional implementing arrangements within the scope of this Agreement and the Memorandum of Cooperation to further facilitate the uninterrupted execution of this Agreement.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1026 ft2">325</P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_326">


<TABLE cellpadding=0 cellspacing=0 class="t118">
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td312"><P class="p17 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td218"><P class="p556 ft19">Article 5</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr4 td312"><P class="p17 ft2">Bilaga 2</P></TD>
	<TD rowspan=2 class="tr2 td218"><P class="p556 ft27">Obligations of the Parties</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr25 td312"><P class="p17 ft58"> </P></TD>
</TR>
</TABLE>
<P class="p788 ft64"><SPAN class="ft2">1.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft115">Estonia consents to the use of the Prison and Estonian staff to enforce Swedish sentences on Estonian territory.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p789 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">2.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">Sweden shall pay the costs for the enforcement of Swedish sentences in accordance with Part XI of this Agreement. Enforcement of Swedish sentences in the Prison shall be based on conditions set out in this Agreement.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p817 ft117"><SPAN class="ft2">3.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft116">Estonia shall make the necessary adjustments, as to be further specified in the Memorandum of Cooperation, to the Prison to ensure that the Prison meets the requirements set out in this Agreement. Estonia shall ensure that the Prison continuously meets these requirements.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1027 ft2">326</P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_327">


<TABLE cellpadding=0 cellspacing=0 class="t78">
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td283"><P class="p845 ft19">Article 6</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td50"><P class="p17 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr26 td283"><P class="p845 ft27">Applicable law</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr26 td50"><P class="p17 ft2">Bilaga 2</P></TD>
</TR>
</TABLE>
<P class="p821 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">1.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">The law and regulations of Estonia with respect to this Agreement and the Memorandum of Cooperation shall be applicable to the enforcement of Swedish sentences in the Prison, including the rights and duties of the Prisoners.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p879 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">2.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">Parts of the Estonian legislation on enforcement of prison sentences shall not apply to the enforcement of Swedish sentences in the Prison. This applies to the scope of the following provisions: § 11 (1) and (3); § 14 (3) and (4); § 16; § 18 (1), (4), (5) and (8) regarding DNA samples; §§ </SPAN><NOBR>19–22;</NOBR> § 31 (3); § 46 (1) last sentence; § 50 (3) last sentence; § 53 (4); Subchapter 6; § 63 (1) <NOBR>1<SPAN class="ft125">1</SPAN>)–4),</NOBR> (2); § 64 (4<SPAN class="ft125">1</SPAN>); § 65<SPAN class="ft125">1</SPAN>; § 67<SPAN class="ft125">1 </SPAN>(3); Subchapter 9; and Chapter 3 of the Estonian Imprisonment Act, including amendments until RT I, 31.12.2024.</P>
<P class="p1028 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">3.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">Parts of the Estonian legislation on enforcement of prison sentences shall be replaced by provisions in this Agreement. This applies to the scope of the following provisions of the Estonian Imprisonment Act, including amendments until RT I, 31.12.2024:</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1029 ft64"><SPAN class="ft2">a.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft113">Article 41.2 of this Agreement shall be applied instead of § 14 (1), last sentence;</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1030 ft2"><SPAN class="ft2">b.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft23">Article 28.3 of this Agreement shall be applied instead of § 28 (2);</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1031 ft2"><SPAN class="ft2">c.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft23">Article 29 of this Agreement shall be applied instead of § 28</SPAN><SPAN class="ft28">1</SPAN>;</P>
<P class="p1030 ft2"><SPAN class="ft2">d.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft23">Part VII of this Agreement shall be applied instead of §§ </SPAN><NOBR>32–33;</NOBR></P>
<P class="p1029 ft64"><SPAN class="ft2">e.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft113">Article 26 and Part VI of this Agreement shall be applied instead of §§ </SPAN><NOBR>34–44;</NOBR></P>
<P class="p1030 ft2"><SPAN class="ft2">f.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft20">Article 17 of this Agreement shall be applied instead of § 47;</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1031 ft2"><SPAN class="ft2">g.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft23">Article 27 of this Agreement shall be applied instead of § 55; and</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1031 ft2"><SPAN class="ft2">h.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft23">Article 42 of this Agreement shall be applied instead of § 56.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p783 ft64"><SPAN class="ft2">4.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft115">Complaints and legal matters concerning the enforcement of Swedish sentences shall be handled by the Estonian authorities, including Estonian courts. However, complaints and legal matters concerning a decision by</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1032 ft2">327</P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_328">


<DIV>
<DIV id="id_1">
<P class="p801 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185 Bilaga 2</P>
<P class="p755 ft2">328</P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="id_2">
<P class="p288 ft117">the Swedish Prison and Probation Service to request enforcement of a Swedish sentence in Estonia in accordance with Article 19 of this Agreement, to come to a different conclusion than the Estonian Prison and Probation Service in accordance with Article 35.2.b of this Agreement or to deny permission in accordance with Article 47.6 of this Agreement, shall be handled by Swedish authorities, including Swedish courts.</P>
<P class="p1033 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">5.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">The law and regulations of Sweden regarding employment and working environment shall apply to the Swedish staff.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1034 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">6.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">The law and regulations of Estonia regarding employment and working environment, shall apply to the Estonian staff.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p448 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">7.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">The law and regulations of Estonia regarding working conditions, including working environment, and insurance, shall apply to the Prisoners during occupational activities.</SPAN></P>
</DIV>
</DIV>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_329">


<TABLE cellpadding=0 cellspacing=0 class="t119">
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td313"><P class="p1035 ft19">Article 7</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td50"><P class="p17 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr26 td313"><P class="p1035 ft27">Competences and responsibilities of the Swedish Prison and Probation</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr26 td50"><P class="p17 ft2">Bilaga 2</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td313"><P class="p1035 ft27">Service</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td50"><P class="p17 ft6"> </P></TD>
</TR>
</TABLE>
<P class="p341 ft2"><SPAN class="ft2">1.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft23">The Swedish Prison and Probation Service shall:</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1030 ft2"><SPAN class="ft2">a.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft23">have the right to monitor the implementation of this Agreement;</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1031 ft2"><SPAN class="ft2">b.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft23">carry out the tasks and duties assigned to it in this Agreement;</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1029 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">c.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft114">provide training to the Estonian staff as agreed upon in the Memorandum of Cooperation; and</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1036 ft2"><SPAN class="ft2">d.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft23">retain its responsibilities as employer for the Swedish staff.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p876 ft64"><SPAN class="ft2">2.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft115">The Swedish Prison and Probation Service shall have the right to make remarks about Estonia’s compliance with this Agreement.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p821 ft117"><SPAN class="ft2">3.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft116">The Swedish Prison and Probation Service may request the Estonian Prison and Probation Service to reassign the duties of a member of the Estonian staff. The Estonian Prison and Probation Service shall give effect to such a request without delay in accordance with the relevant law and regulations of Estonia.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p190 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">4.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">The Swedish staff shall have access to the Prison and all information regarding the enforcement of Swedish sentences. The Swedish staff shall also have the right to attend the staff meetings of the Prison.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1037 ft2">329</P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_330">


<TABLE cellpadding=0 cellspacing=0 class="t120">
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td183"><P class="p17 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td314"><P class="p556 ft19">Article 8</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr4 td183"><P class="p17 ft2">Bilaga 2</P></TD>
	<TD rowspan=2 class="tr2 td314"><P class="p556 ft27">Competences and responsibilities of the Estonian Prison and Probation</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr25 td183"><P class="p17 ft58"> </P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td183"><P class="p17 ft6"> </P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td314"><P class="p787 ft27">Service</P></TD>
</TR>
</TABLE>
<P class="p873 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">1.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">The Estonian Prison and Probation Service is responsible for the following:</SPAN></P>
<P class="p910 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">a.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft114">within the Prison, the enforcement of Swedish sentences, maintaining order and security and the treatment of Prisoners;</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1038 ft117"><SPAN class="ft2">b.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft116">in accordance with point a, the authorisation and use of direct force against Prisoners, including the use of measures of restraint in accordance with this Agreement and the relevant law and regulations of Estonia, with a view to maintain order and security in the Prison;</SPAN></P>
<P class="p962 ft2"><SPAN class="ft2">c.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft20">providing for the overall security arrangements in the Prison;</SPAN></P>
<P class="p859 ft2"><SPAN class="ft2">d.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft20">overseeing the Estonian staff for the purposes of this Agreement;</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1039 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">e.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft114">keeping a record for each Prisoner that documents the enforcement of a Swedish sentence and which includes the time of, and member of Estonian staff responsible for, each entry;</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1039 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">f.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">facilitating the communication between the Swedish Prison and Probation Service, the Swedish staff, and relevant Estonian authorities; and</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1040 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">g.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">implementing the law and procedures of the Estonian staff related to the enforcement of Swedish sentences.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p790 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">2.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">Estonia guarantees that the treatment of prisoners and other measures undertaken under this Article to maintain order and security meet the standards set out in the European Prison Rules and the CPT Standards.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p817 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">3.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">The Estonian Prison and Probation Service shall, without prejudice to Article 7.3, take immediate measures and initiate disciplinary procedures in the event of violations by the Estonian staff.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p790 ft117"><SPAN class="ft2">4.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft116">The Estonian Prison and Probation Service shall review and decide on complaints from Prisoners in matters concerning the Estonian staff. The Estonian Prison and Probation Service shall consult the Swedish Prison and Probation Service when such cases are being decided.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p446 ft2">330</P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_331">


<TABLE cellpadding=0 cellspacing=0 class="t70">
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td276"><P class="p1041 ft19">PART II</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td50"><P class="p17 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr26 td276"><P class="p818 ft19">JURISDICTION</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr26 td50"><P class="p17 ft2">Bilaga 2</P></TD>
</TR>
</TABLE>
<P class="p1042 ft19">Article 9</P>
<P class="p1043 ft3">Prosecution of criminal offences</P>
<P class="p821 ft109">If a criminal offence is committed by a Prisoner or a member of the Swedish staff in Estonia and the criminal offence falls within the jurisdiction of both Sweden and Estonia, Swedish and Estonian authorities shall cooperate to determine which State is to bring criminal proceedings. The matter shall, where appropriate, be referred to Eurojust in accordance with Article 12(2) of Council Framework Decision 2009/948/JHA of 30 November 2009 on prevention and settlement of conflicts of exercise of jurisdiction in criminal proceedings.</P>
<P class="p1044 ft2">331</P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_332">


<TABLE cellpadding=0 cellspacing=0 class="t121">
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td61"><P class="p17 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td315"><P class="p556 ft19">Article 10</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr4 td61"><P class="p17 ft2">Bilaga 2</P></TD>
	<TD rowspan=2 class="tr2 td315"><P class="p556 ft27">Responsibility to report alleged criminal offences</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr25 td61"><P class="p17 ft58"> </P></TD>
</TR>
</TABLE>
<P class="p789 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">1.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">If required by the relevant law or regulations of Estonia, the Estonian Prison and Probation Service is responsible for reporting alleged criminal offences within the Prison to the relevant Swedish authorities.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p790 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">2.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">If required by the relevant law or regulations of Sweden, the Swedish Prison and Probation Service is responsible for reporting the alleged criminal offences within the Prison to the relevant Swedish authorities.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p823 ft2">332</P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_333">


<TABLE cellpadding=0 cellspacing=0 class="t122">
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td137"><P class="p1045 ft19">Article 11</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td50"><P class="p17 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr26 td137"><P class="p1046 ft27">Investigation by Estonia of alleged criminal offences</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr26 td50"><P class="p17 ft2">Bilaga 2</P></TD>
</TR>
</TABLE>
<P class="p771 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">1.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">If requested by Sweden or the Swedish authorities, Estonia shall provide information on ongoing investigations and the outcome of the criminal proceedings.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p832 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">2.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">Interrogations of Prisoners as suspects, victims or witnesses and other investigative acts that affect them shall, where the interests of the investigation allow it, take place within the Prison as far as possible.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p846 ft64"><SPAN class="ft2">3.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft115">This Article is without prejudice to the rights and duties set out in Article 47.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1047 ft2">333</P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_334">


<TABLE cellpadding=0 cellspacing=0 class="t123">
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td178"><P class="p17 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td64"><P class="p556 ft19">Article 12</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr4 td178"><P class="p17 ft2">Bilaga 2</P></TD>
	<TD rowspan=2 class="tr2 td64"><P class="p556 ft27">Hearings and participation through audio and video transmission</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr25 td178"><P class="p17 ft58"> </P></TD>
</TR>
</TABLE>
<P class="p439 ft2"><SPAN class="ft2">1.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft23">Swedish authorities and courts shall have the possibility to hear a</SPAN></P>
<P class="p670 ft117">Prisoner or ensure a Prisoner’s participation in proceedings before the authority or court through audio transmission or audio and video transmission in accordance with applicable Swedish legislation. The Estonian Prison and Probation Service shall facilitate the hearing and participation of the Prisoner.</P>
<P class="p837 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">2.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">This Article is without prejudice to legal instruments in force between the Parties.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p829 ft2">334</P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_335">


<TABLE cellpadding=0 cellspacing=0 class="t124">
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td41"><P class="p1048 ft19">PART III</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td50"><P class="p17 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr26 td41"><P class="p1048 ft19">THE PRISON</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr26 td50"><P class="p17 ft2">Bilaga 2</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr20 td41"><P class="p1049 ft19">Article 13</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr20 td50"><P class="p17 ft6"> </P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td41"><P class="p1048 ft27">Prison capacity and conditions</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td50"><P class="p17 ft6"> </P></TD>
</TR>
</TABLE>
<P class="p342 ft2"><SPAN class="ft2">1.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft23">Estonia shall make 400 cells available with capacity to house up to</SPAN></P>
<P class="p968 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">600</SPAN><SPAN class="ft114">Prisoners in the Prison. The capacity shall be in the form of single occupancy cells or </SPAN><NOBR>multi-occupancy</NOBR> cells for no more than two Prisoners.</P>
<P class="p784 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">2.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">Estonia guarantees that the conditions in the Prison meet the standards set out in the European Prison Rules and the CPT Standards.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p877 ft117"><SPAN class="ft2">3.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft116">A Prisoner’s cell shall be equipped with at least a chair, a table, a cabinet or a shelf, a bed, appropriate bedding, a mirror, a bulletin board, a cell terminal for communication with members of the Estonian staff, a mug, an alarm clock, a radio, a television, and a device that allows the Prisoner to regulate the inflow of daylight.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p694 ft117"><SPAN class="ft2">4.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft116">By way of derogation from paragraph 3, a Prisoner’s cell may be equipped differently if there is a risk that the Prisoner will seriously harm himself or others or commit vandalism, or if he is isolated for body inspection. In that case, the Prisoner’s room shall, as far as possible and based on order and security considerations, be equipped with the items described in paragraph 3.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p694 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">5.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">The use of tobacco and nicotine products for Prisoners and members of the Swedish staff shall be further regulated in the Memorandum of Cooperation.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1050 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">6.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">In the event of significant changes in the law and regulations of Estonia concerning prison conditions or the rights and duties of the Prisoners, the Parties agree to hold consultations in accordance with Article 58.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1051 ft2">335</P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_336">


<TABLE cellpadding=0 cellspacing=0 class="t125">
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td79"><P class="p17 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td307"><P class="p556 ft19">Article 14</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr4 td79"><P class="p17 ft2">Bilaga 2</P></TD>
	<TD rowspan=2 class="tr2 td307"><P class="p556 ft27">Language and the right to information</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr25 td79"><P class="p17 ft58"> </P></TD>
</TR>
</TABLE>
<P class="p836 ft117"><SPAN class="ft2">1.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft116">The working language of the Prison shall be English. Another language may be used when a member of the Estonian staff communicates with another member of the Estonian staff or when a member of the Swedish staff communicates with another member of the Swedish staff or with a Prisoner.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1052 ft64"><SPAN class="ft2">2.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft115">All official documents and other documentation shall be drafted in or translated into English.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p836 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">3.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">Prisoners shall have the right to an interpreter and to have documents translated if this is necessary for the Prisoner to exercise his rights, including but not limited to submitting and pursuing complaints in matters where the law and regulations of Estonia is applicable according to Article 6.1 and when exercising the right to medical care in accordance with Article 41. This shall be provided for by the Estonian Prison and Probation Service.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1053 ft64"><SPAN class="ft2">4.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft115">Prisoners shall have the right to be fully informed of their rights and obligations during the enforcement of a Swedish sentence in Estonia.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1054 ft2">336</P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_337">


<TABLE cellpadding=0 cellspacing=0 class="t126">
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td222"><P class="p839 ft19">Article 15</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td50"><P class="p17 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr26 td222"><P class="p1055 ft3">Staff</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr26 td50"><P class="p17 ft2">Bilaga 2</P></TD>
</TR>
</TABLE>
<P class="p1056 ft117"><SPAN class="ft2">1.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft116">Estonia shall provide the staff necessary to implement this Agreement and the Memorandum of Cooperation according to Article 8 and to the needs specified by the Swedish Prison and Probation Service. The composition of the Estonian staff shall be further specified in the Memorandum of Cooperation. The Estonian staff shall receive education and training as to be further specified in the Memorandum of Cooperation.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p841 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">2.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">Sweden shall provide the staff necessary to implement this Agreement and the Memorandum of Cooperation in accordance with Article 7.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p842 ft2">337</P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_338">


<TABLE cellpadding=0 cellspacing=0 class="t105">
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td301"><P class="p17 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td302"><P class="p556 ft19">Article 16</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr4 td301"><P class="p17 ft2">Bilaga 2</P></TD>
	<TD rowspan=2 class="tr2 td302"><P class="p556 ft27">Security of the Prison</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr25 td301"><P class="p17 ft58"> </P></TD>
</TR>
</TABLE>
<P class="p789 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">1.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">Estonia is responsible for enforcing public order and safety outside the Prison. Estonia shall take the necessary measures for the undisturbed operation of the Prison and to prevent the disturbance of public order in the immediate vicinity of the Prison.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p873 ft64"><SPAN class="ft2">2.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft115">The security in the Prison shall be the responsibility of the Estonian Prison and Probation Service in accordance with Article 8.1.a.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p844 ft2">338</P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_339">


<TABLE cellpadding=0 cellspacing=0 class="t127">
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td14"><P class="p1057 ft19">Article 17</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td50"><P class="p17 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr26 td14"><P class="p1058 ft27">Food in the Prison</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr26 td50"><P class="p17 ft2">Bilaga 2</P></TD>
</TR>
</TABLE>
<P class="p342 ft2"><SPAN class="ft2">1.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft23">Prisoners shall be provided food in the Prison in accordance with the</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1059 ft2">Nordic Counsel of Ministers’ Nordic Nutrition Recommendations.</P>
<P class="p821 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">2.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">A Prisoner is entitled to food that is adapted to his medical needs. To the extent possible, consideration shall also be given to the Prisoner’s religion. A Prisoner has the right to receive vegetarian food.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p877 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">3.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">A Prisoner is entitled to receive meals at customary mealtimes. The Prisoner shall be given the opportunity to eat at times adapted to his medical needs or religion.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1060 ft64"><SPAN class="ft2">4.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft115">During Prisoners’ leisure time, a Prisoner has the right to prepare or receive hot beverages, unless this would jeopardise order or security.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1061 ft2">339</P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_340">


<TABLE cellpadding=0 cellspacing=0 class="t128">
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td217"><P class="p17 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td272"><P class="p581 ft19">Article 18</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr4 td217"><P class="p17 ft2">Bilaga 2</P></TD>
	<TD rowspan=2 class="tr2 td272"><P class="p556 ft27">Evacuation of the Prison in the event of an emergency</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr25 td217"><P class="p17 ft58"> </P></TD>
</TR>
</TABLE>
<P class="p789 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">1.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">If the Prison must be evacuated in the event of an emergency, the Prisoners shall be transferred to another location designated by the Estonian Prison and Probation Service, with a view to their immediate transfer to Sweden if necessary due to the reason for the evacuation.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p946 ft117"><SPAN class="ft2">2.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft116">The Swedish Prison and Probation Service and the Estonian Prison and Probation Service shall carry out exercises in a format of their choice to practice the procedures for evacuating Prisoners in the Prison under special circumstances (such as a state of emergency, a crisis situation, heightened defence readiness or war).</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1062 ft2">340</P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_341">


<TABLE cellpadding=0 cellspacing=0 class="t129">
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td316"><P class="p1063 ft19">PART IV</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td50"><P class="p17 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr26 td316"><P class="p1063 ft19">PROCEDURES</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr26 td50"><P class="p17 ft2">Bilaga 2</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr20 td316"><P class="p1064 ft19">Article 19</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr20 td50"><P class="p17 ft6"> </P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td316"><P class="p1063 ft3">Request for enforcement</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td50"><P class="p17 ft6"> </P></TD>
</TR>
</TABLE>
<P class="p889 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">1.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">Before the commencement of an enforcement of a Swedish sentence in Estonia, the Swedish Prison and Probation Service shall make a request for enforcement to the Estonian Ministry of Justice and Digital Affairs. The Swedish Prison and Probation Service shall not make more than</SPAN></P>
<P class="p559 ft2"><SPAN class="ft2">30</SPAN><SPAN class="ft20">requests within a period of ten (10) days.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p889 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">2.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">The request shall include the date on which the enforcement in Estonia will cease. The enforcement in Estonia shall cease no later than one month before the date for conditional release or the date for enforcement of an expulsion order.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p890 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">3.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">The request shall also include information about the Swedish sentence and its enforcement necessary for the evaluation of the request’s compliance with this Agreement.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p891 ft117"><SPAN class="ft2">4.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft116">The Estonian Ministry of Justice and Digital Affairs shall handle a request within ten (10) days. If more than 20 requests are made within ten (10) days, the requests filed within that period shall be handled within fifteen (15) days.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p86 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">5.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">The request shall be granted if the conditions in Article 20 are met and Estonian courts have determined that substantially similar acts are punishable under Estonian law, the sentence to be executed is not unconscionably harsh and the time period between the entry into force of the judgment and the commencement of its enforcement does not exceed three (3) years.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p889 ft117"><SPAN class="ft2">6.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft116">If the request is granted, the Estonian Ministry of Justice and Digital Affairs shall immediately notify the Swedish Prison and Probation Service of the date on which the enforcement of the Swedish sentence can be initiated in the Prison at the earliest. Subject to prison capacity, the enforcement of the Swedish sentence in Estonia shall be initiated as soon as possible.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p87 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">7.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">If the Estonian Ministry of Justice and Digital Affairs make a dissenting assessment of whether a person should be considered a high security risk in accordance with Article 20.2.e, the Estonian Ministry of Justice and</SPAN></P>
<TABLE cellpadding=0 cellspacing=0 class="t130">
<TR>
	<TD class="tr5 td194"><P class="p17 ft2">Digital Affairs may deny the request. If the request is denied, the Estonian</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr5 td85"><P class="p15 ft2">341</P></TD>
</TR>
</TABLE>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_342">


<P class="p560 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185 Ministry of Justice and Digital Affairs shall immediately notify the</P>
<TABLE cellpadding=0 cellspacing=0 class="t88">
<TR>
	<TD class="tr26 td111"><P class="p17 ft2">Bilaga 2</P></TD>
	<TD rowspan=2 class="tr15 td290"><P class="p17 ft26">Swedish Prison and Probations Service and provide the grounds for denial.</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr25 td111"><P class="p17 ft58"> </P></TD>
</TR>
</TABLE>
<P class="p1065 ft2">342</P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_343">


<DIV id="id_1">
<DIV id="id_1_1">
<P class="p1066 ft19">Article 20</P>
<P class="p1067 ft3">Convicted persons excluded from enforcement of a Swedish sentence in</P>
<P class="p853 ft3">Estonia</P>
<P class="p915 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">1.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">The Swedish Prison and Probation Service shall not request the enforcement of a Swedish sentence in Estonia if the convicted person:</SPAN></P>
<P class="p762 ft2"><SPAN class="ft2">a.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft23">is female;</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1068 ft2"><SPAN class="ft2">b.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft23">is under the age of 18;</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1069 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">c.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft114">at the time of the request for enforcement, has a confirmed terminal diagnosis or a serious physical or mental disorder and is in need of medical care outside the Prison;</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1069 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">d.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">is sentenced to forensic mental health care under the Swedish Forensic Mental Health Care Act (1991:1129) or is otherwise receiving care under that Act;</SPAN></P>
<P class="p762 ft2"><SPAN class="ft2">e.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft23">is a recipient of Swedish retirement pension;</SPAN></P>
<P class="p803 ft2"><SPAN class="ft2">f.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft20">is an Estonian citizen or permanent resident of Estonia;</SPAN></P>
<P class="p916 ft64"><SPAN class="ft2">g.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft115">is a person that has been declared a fugitive from justice by an Estonian authority;</SPAN></P>
<P class="p916 ft64"><SPAN class="ft2">h.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft115">is deemed a persona non grata in Estonia or is banned by Estonian authorities from entering Estonia on other grounds.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p956 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">2.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">The Swedish Prison and Probation Service shall not request the enforcement of a Swedish sentence in Estonia for a person that constitutes a high security risk because that person:</SPAN></P>
<P class="p805 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">a.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft114">has been convicted of an offence under the Swedish Terrorist Offences Act (2022:666);</SPAN></P>
<P class="p805 ft64"><SPAN class="ft2">b.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft115">has been convicted of an offence under Chapter 19 in the Swedish Penal Code (1962:700);</SPAN></P>
<P class="p916 ft64"><SPAN class="ft2">c.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft113">is a party in a case or matter under the Swedish Act on Special Control of Certain Foreign Nationals (2022:700);</SPAN></P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="id_1_2">
<P class="p14 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185 Bilaga 2</P>
</DIV>
</DIV>
<DIV id="id_2">
<P class="p14 ft2">343</P>
</DIV>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_344">


<DIV>
<DIV id="id_1">
<P class="p1070 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185 Bilaga 2</P>
<P class="p755 ft2">344</P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="id_2">
<P class="p14 ft64">d. is or has been subject to review in a security case under the Swedish Aliens Act (2005:716); or</P>
<P class="p1071 ft64">e. is otherwise considered a high security risk by the Swedish Prison and Probation Service.</P>
</DIV>
</DIV>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_345">


<TABLE cellpadding=0 cellspacing=0 class="t131">
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td257"><P class="p1072 ft19">Article 21</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td50"><P class="p17 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr26 td257"><P class="p1073 ft27">Commencement of enforcement in Estonia</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr26 td50"><P class="p17 ft2">Bilaga 2</P></TD>
</TR>
</TABLE>
<P class="p821 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">1.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">Once a request for enforcement is granted by the Estonian Ministry of Justice and Digital Affairs, the Swedish Prison and Probation Service may transfer the Prisoner to Estonia from the date notified by the Estonian Ministry of Justice and Digital Affairs in accordance with Article 19.6.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p341 ft2"><SPAN class="ft2">2.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft23">This Agreement serves as a legal basis for a Prisoner’s entry and stay in</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1074 ft64">Estonia for the duration of the enforcement of the Swedish sentence in the Prison.</P>
<P class="p1075 ft2">345</P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_346">


<TABLE cellpadding=0 cellspacing=0 class="t75">
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td280"><P class="p17 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td281"><P class="p581 ft19">Article 22</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr4 td280"><P class="p17 ft2">Bilaga 2</P></TD>
	<TD rowspan=2 class="tr2 td281"><P class="p556 ft27">Cease of enforcement in Estonia</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr25 td280"><P class="p17 ft58"> </P></TD>
</TR>
</TABLE>
<P class="p788 ft64"><SPAN class="ft2">1.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft115">The Prisoner shall be transported from Estonia to Sweden no later than the date specified in accordance with Article 19.2.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p836 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">2.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">The Swedish Prison and Probation Service may decide that the enforcement in Estonia shall cease earlier than the date specified in accordance with Article 19.2.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p692 ft117"><SPAN class="ft2">3.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft116">The Estonian Prison and Probation Service may request that the Swedish Prison and Probation Service decide that the enforcement in Estonia shall cease earlier than the date specified in accordance with Article 19.2. If the request is based upon a changed assessment of whether a person should be considered a high security risk according to Article 20.2.e, the Swedish Prison and Probation Service shall immediately grant such a request.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p108 ft2">346</P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_347">


<TABLE cellpadding=0 cellspacing=0 class="t6">
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td90"><P class="p970 ft19">Article 23</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td50"><P class="p17 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr26 td90"><P class="p867 ft27">Extension of the period of enforcement in Estonia</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr26 td50"><P class="p17 ft2">Bilaga 2</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr20 td90"><P class="p867 ft26">The date on which the enforcement in Estonia shall cease may be extended</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr20 td50"><P class="p17 ft6"> </P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td90"><P class="p867 ft2">upon request by the Swedish Prison and Probation Service. The Estonian</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td50"><P class="p17 ft6"> </P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td90"><P class="p867 ft26">Prison and Probation Service shall handle such requests in accordance with</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td50"><P class="p17 ft6"> </P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr26 td90"><P class="p17 ft2">Articles <NOBR>19.4.–19.6.</NOBR></P></TD>
	<TD class="tr26 td50"><P class="p17 ft6"> </P></TD>
</TR>
</TABLE>
<P class="p1076 ft2">347</P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_348">


<TABLE cellpadding=0 cellspacing=0 class="t68">
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td34"><P class="p17 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td274"><P class="p556 ft19">Article 24</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr4 td34"><P class="p17 ft2">Bilaga 2</P></TD>
	<TD rowspan=2 class="tr2 td274"><P class="p556 ft3">Transport of Prisoners</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr25 td34"><P class="p17 ft58"> </P></TD>
</TR>
</TABLE>
<P class="p788 ft64"><SPAN class="ft2">1.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft115">The Swedish Prison and Probation Service is responsible for the transport of Prisoners to and from Estonian territory.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p789 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">2.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">The Estonian Prison and Probation Service is responsible for the transport of Prisoners within Estonian territory, including transports to and from Estonian airports and borders.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1077 ft127"><SPAN class="ft2">3.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft126">Before the handover of a Prisoner to the Swedish Prison and Probation Service, the Estonian Prison and Probation Service is responsible for guaranteeing that the Prisoner has been subjected to the necessary security procedures, in accordance with the law and regulations of Estonia.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1078 ft121"><SPAN class="ft2">4.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft120">Before the handover of a Prisoner to the Estonian Prison and Probation Service, the Swedish Prison and Probation Service is responsible for guaranteeing that the Prisoner has been subjected to the necessary security procedures, in accordance with the law and regulations of Sweden.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p946 ft117"><SPAN class="ft2">5.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft116">Upon request from the Swedish Prison and Probation Service, the Estonian Prison and Probation Service may carry out a transport that would otherwise be under the responsibility of the Swedish Prison and Probation Service in accordance with paragraph 1. This does not apply to transports on Swedish territory.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p872 ft117"><SPAN class="ft2">6.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft116">During the transport of Prisoners by the Estonian Prison and Probation Service, coercive measures, including measures of restraint, may be used by the Estonian staff for reasons of safety and the undisturbed progress of the transport, in accordance with the law and regulations of Estonia and this Agreement.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1079 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">7.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">The Swedish staff may participate as observers in transports carried out by the Estonian Prison and Probation Service.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p692 ft117"><SPAN class="ft2">8.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft116">The Estonian Prison and Probation Service is authorised to impose sanctions and measures in accordance with the relevant law and regulations in Estonia and this Agreement for any disciplinary breaches committed by a Prisoner during the transport within Estonian territory.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1080 ft2">348</P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_349">


<TABLE cellpadding=0 cellspacing=0 class="t126">
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td222"><P class="p839 ft19">Article 25</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td50"><P class="p17 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr26 td222"><P class="p1055 ft3">Escape</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr26 td50"><P class="p17 ft2">Bilaga 2</P></TD>
</TR>
</TABLE>
<P class="p771 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">1.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">In the event of an escape of a Prisoner, the Estonian staff shall immediately inform the Estonian police and the Swedish Prison and Probation Service about the identity of that Prisoner. Other relevant information shall also be provided.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p808 ft117"><SPAN class="ft2">2.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft116">The Estonian Prison and Probation Service shall, if required by the law or regulations of Estonia, report the event to relevant Estonian authorities. Estonian authorities shall be responsible for issuing any relevant warrants in accordance with the law and regulations of Estonia.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p833 ft117"><SPAN class="ft2">3.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft116">The Swedish Prison and Probation Service shall, if required by the law or regulations of Sweden, report the event to relevant Swedish authorities. Swedish authorities shall be responsible for issuing any relevant warrants in accordance with the law and regulations of Sweden.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p871 ft2">349</P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_350">


<TABLE cellpadding=0 cellspacing=0 class="t132">
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td155"><P class="p17 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td276"><P class="p556 ft19">PART V</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr4 td155"><P class="p17 ft2">Bilaga 2</P></TD>
	<TD rowspan=2 class="tr2 td276"><P class="p556 ft19">CONDITIONS FOR THE ENFORCEMENT</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr25 td155"><P class="p17 ft58"> </P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr20 td155"><P class="p17 ft6"> </P></TD>
	<TD class="tr20 td276"><P class="p556 ft19">Article 26</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td155"><P class="p17 ft6"> </P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td276"><P class="p556 ft27">Occupational activities</P></TD>
</TR>
</TABLE>
<P class="p836 ft117"><SPAN class="ft2">1.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft116">A Prisoner shall be given the opportunity to take part in occupational activities in the form of work, education, training, programmes related to crime and misuse or other structured occupational activity. The Estonian Prison and Probation Service may request assistance from the Swedish Prison and Probation Service in offering education and programmes related to crime and misuse.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p724 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">2.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">A Prisoner shall be offered at least 30 hours of occupational activity per week. The Prisoner shall, as far as possible, be assigned occupational activities aimed at preventing recidivism or otherwise facilitating the Prisoner’s reintegration into society. Consideration shall be given to the</SPAN></P>
<P class="p687 ft2">Prisoner’s motivation for change.</P>
<P class="p946 ft117"><SPAN class="ft2">3.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft116">A Prisoner is obliged to carry out or take part in the occupational activity assigned to him. A Prisoner who has been granted sickness compensation or activity compensation in accordance with the Swedish Social Insurance Code may only be required to undertake occupation of the nature and to the extent that can be regarded as suitable for him. A Prisoner may not be required to submit to treatment of medical character.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p872 ft117"><SPAN class="ft2">4.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft116">A Prisoner may be assigned occupational activities from Monday to Friday, excluding Swedish public holidays, between 07.30 and 19.00. However, if the nature of the activity or other specific circumstances require it, a Prisoner may be assigned occupational activities at other times as well.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p947 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">5.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">A Prisoner is entitled to two days off from work per week, unless there are special reasons against it.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1081 ft2">350</P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_351">


<TABLE cellpadding=0 cellspacing=0 class="t133">
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td241"><P class="p1082 ft19">Article 27</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td50"><P class="p17 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr26 td241"><P class="p1083 ft3">Prisoners’ leisure time</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr26 td50"><P class="p17 ft2">Bilaga 2</P></TD>
</TR>
</TABLE>
<P class="p771 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">1.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">A Prisoner shall be given the opportunity to spend at least one hour each day outdoors unless there are exceptional reasons not to provide this opportunity.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p832 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">2.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">A Prisoner shall be given the opportunity to engage, in a suitable way, in physical or other recreational activities. Those activities shall be of a varied nature.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p808 ft117"><SPAN class="ft2">3.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft116">A Prisoner shall be given the opportunity to follow, in a suitable way, events in the outside world. This includes, but is not limited to, access to a varied selection of literature in Swedish, Swedish public information and Swedish television channels as to be specified in the Memorandum of Cooperation.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p834 ft64"><SPAN class="ft2">4.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft115">A Prisoner shall be given the opportunity of practising his religion in a suitable way.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1056 ft64"><SPAN class="ft2">5.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft115">A Prisoner shall be given the opportunity to meet with other Prisoners in a suitable way to discuss matters of common interest to the Prisoners (a</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1084 ft64">Prisoners’ council). A Prisoners’ council shall be given the opportunity to hold discussions in a suitable way with the Estonian staff.</P>
<P class="p1085 ft2">351</P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_352">


<TABLE cellpadding=0 cellspacing=0 class="t134">
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td317"><P class="p17 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td288"><P class="p556 ft19">Article 28</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr4 td317"><P class="p17 ft2">Bilaga 2</P></TD>
	<TD rowspan=2 class="tr2 td288"><P class="p556 ft27">Prisoners’ electronic communication</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr25 td317"><P class="p17 ft58"> </P></TD>
</TR>
</TABLE>
<P class="p836 ft117"><SPAN class="ft2">1.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft116">Without prejudice to Article 47, a Prisoner may use electronic communication from the Prison only upon permission from the Estonian Prison and Probation Service. An application for such permission should be filed with and handled by the Estonian Prison and Probation Service. Such an application shall be granted if the conditions in paragraph 2 are met.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p748 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">2.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">A Prisoner may be in contact with another person through electronic communication to the extent that this can be conveniently arranged. Such communication may be refused if it may:</SPAN></P>
