<P class="p859 ft2"><SPAN class="ft2">a.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft20">jeopardise security;</SPAN></P>
<P class="p859 ft2"><SPAN class="ft2">b.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft20">counteract the Prisoner’s adjustment in the community; or</SPAN></P>
<P class="p883 ft2"><SPAN class="ft2">c.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft20">be harmful in some other way to the Prisoner or another person.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p817 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">3.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">A Prisoner may be charged for the costs of his electronic communication as to be further specified in the Memorandum of Cooperation.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p912 ft2">352</P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_353">


<TABLE cellpadding=0 cellspacing=0 class="t135">
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td126"><P class="p1086 ft19">Article 29</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td50"><P class="p17 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr26 td126"><P class="p1087 ft27">Prisoners’ correspondence and parcels</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr26 td50"><P class="p17 ft2">Bilaga 2</P></TD>
</TR>
</TABLE>
<P class="p783 ft121"><SPAN class="ft2">1.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft120">The Swedish Prison and Probation Service shall be responsible for the handling of Prisoners’ postal service including the forwarding of correspondence and parcels to the Swedish Postal Service. The Estonian Prison and Probation Service shall assist the Swedish Prison and Probation</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1059 ft2">Service in handling Prisoners’ correspondence and parcels.</P>
<P class="p342 ft2"><SPAN class="ft2">2.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft23">Without prejudice to paragraph 1, the Estonian Prison and Probation</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1088 ft109">Service shall be responsible for the handling of Prisoners’ correspondence with Estonian public authorities and Estonian legal representatives.</P>
<P class="p1089 ft2">353</P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_354">


<TABLE cellpadding=0 cellspacing=0 class="t88">
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td111"><P class="p17 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td290"><P class="p556 ft19">Article 30</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr4 td111"><P class="p17 ft2">Bilaga 2</P></TD>
	<TD rowspan=2 class="tr2 td290"><P class="p556 ft27">Prisoners’ personal belongings</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr25 td111"><P class="p17 ft58"> </P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr20 td111"><P class="p17 ft6"> </P></TD>
	<TD class="tr20 td290"><P class="p556 ft2">Prisoners shall be entitled to bring personal belongings as to be further</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td111"><P class="p17 ft6"> </P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td290"><P class="p17 ft2">specified in the Memorandum of Cooperation.</P></TD>
</TR>
</TABLE>
<P class="p887 ft2">354</P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_355">


<TABLE cellpadding=0 cellspacing=0 class="t136">
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td117"><P class="p1090 ft19">PART VI</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td50"><P class="p17 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr26 td117"><P class="p1090 ft19">PRISONERS’ FUNDS AND REMUNERATION</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr26 td50"><P class="p17 ft2">Bilaga 2</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr20 td117"><P class="p1091 ft19">Article 31</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr20 td50"><P class="p17 ft6"> </P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td117"><P class="p1090 ft27">Administration of Prisoners’ funds</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td50"><P class="p17 ft6"> </P></TD>
</TR>
</TABLE>
<P class="p889 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">1.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">In connection with the commencement of the enforcement of a Swedish sentence in the Prison, the Swedish Prison and Probation Service shall, on the day of the transfer to the Prison, inform the Estonian Prison and</SPAN></P>
<P class="p363 ft117">Probation Service of the balance of the Prisoner’s account with the Swedish Prison and Probation Service. That balance shall be stated in euros after a conversion has been made in accordance with the exchange rate determined by the European Central Bank on the day of the transfer to the Prison.</P>
<P class="p85 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">2.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">The Estonian Prison and Probation Service is responsible for making funds corresponding to the balance mentioned in paragraph 1 available in a Prisoner’s account with the Estonian Prison and Probation Service.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1092 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">3.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">During the enforcement of a Swedish sentence in the Prison, the Estonian Prison and Probation Service shall continuously make funds available in the Prisoner’s account with the Estonian Prison and Probation</SPAN></P>
<P class="p363 ft109">Service, corresponding to the remuneration for occupational activities as set out in Article 32. Such funds shall be available for use in the kiosk of the Prison.</P>
<P class="p65 ft2"><SPAN class="ft2">4.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft23">If a Prisoner receives deposits to his Prisoner’s account with the</SPAN></P>
<P class="p363 ft109">Swedish Prison and Probation Service, the Swedish Prison and Probation Service shall report such deposits to the Estonian Prison and Probation Service. Deposits shall be stated in euros after a conversion has been made in accordance with the exchange rate determined by the European Central Bank on the day that the deposit is made. The Estonian Prison and Probation Service shall continuously make funds available in the Prisoner’s account with the Estonian Prison and Probation Service corresponding to such deposits and in accordance with the Memorandum of Cooperation.</P>
<P class="p1093 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">5.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">A Prisoner shall have the right to transfer funds from his Prisoner’s account as to be further specified in the Memorandum of Cooperation. All transfers of funds from the Prisoner’s account shall be managed by the</SPAN></P>
<P class="p559 ft2">Swedish Prison and Probation Service.</P>
<P class="p65 ft2"><SPAN class="ft2">6.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft23">The Swedish Prison and Probation Service shall, upon request from the</SPAN></P>
<TABLE cellpadding=0 cellspacing=0 class="t90">
<TR>
	<TD class="tr5 td194"><P class="p17 ft2">Estonian Prison and Probation Service, inform the Estonian Prison and</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr5 td85"><P class="p15 ft2">355</P></TD>
</TR>
</TABLE>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_356">


<DIV>
<DIV id="id_1">
<P class="p801 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185 Bilaga 2</P>
<P class="p755 ft2">356</P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="id_2">
<P class="p565 ft109">Probation Service of the balance of the Prisoner’s account with the Swedish Prison and Probation Service. That balance shall be stated in euros after a conversion has been made in accordance with the exchange rate determined by the European Central Bank on the day of the request.</P>
<P class="p776 ft64"><SPAN class="ft2">7.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft115">The Estonian Prison and Probation Service shall, upon request from the Swedish Prison and Probation Service, inform the Swedish Prison and</SPAN></P>
<P class="p19 ft2">Probation Service of the balance of the Prisoner’s account with the</P>
<P class="p19 ft2">Estonian Prison and Probation Service.</P>
<P class="p776 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">8.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">In connection with the cease of the enforcement of a Swedish sentence in the Prison, the Estonian Prison and Probation Service shall, on the day of the transfer from the Prison, inform the Swedish Prison and Probation Service about the balance of the Prisoner’s account with the Estonian</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1094 ft109">Prison and Probation Service and of the amount of remuneration that has been withheld in accordance with Article 33. That balance shall be stated in euros.</P>
<P class="p1017 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">9.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">A Prisoner’s account with the Estonian Prison and Probation Service shall be closed for deposits other than those covered by this Agreement or the Memorandum of Cooperation.</SPAN></P>
</DIV>
</DIV>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_357">


<TABLE cellpadding=0 cellspacing=0 class="t72">
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td168"><P class="p1095 ft19">Article 32</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td50"><P class="p17 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr26 td168"><P class="p824 ft27">Remuneration for occupational activities</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr26 td50"><P class="p17 ft2">Bilaga 2</P></TD>
</TR>
</TABLE>
<P class="p771 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">1.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">A Prisoner is entitled to remuneration if he has carried out or participated in an assigned occupational activity under the condition that remuneration for the occupational activity is not being paid for by another person or body.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p808 ft117"><SPAN class="ft2">2.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft116">A Prisoner is entitled to remuneration of no less than EUR 1.6 per hour (standard remuneration) for the time the Prisoner participates in or performs assigned occupational activities (occupational time). The level of the standard remuneration is to be specified in the Memorandum of Cooperation.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p833 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">3.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">If a Prisoner, while working, performs significantly below expected performance, the standard remuneration shall be reduced to no less than EUR 1 per hour (reduced remuneration). The level of the reduced remuneration is to be specified in the Memorandum of Cooperation. The standard remuneration may only be reduced if the Prisoner, after being informed that a reduction may occur, does not improve his performance. The reduced remuneration shall apply until the Prisoner performs in line with what can be expected of him.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1096 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">4.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">Occupational time includes time spent between activities during the day, and breaks totalling up to 30 minutes per day. The lunch break is not included in the occupational time.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p772 ft64"><SPAN class="ft2">5.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft115">If a Prisoner otherwise would have performed or participated in occupational activities, occupational time also includes time spent on:</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1097 ft64"><SPAN class="ft2">a.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft113">planned and </SPAN><NOBR>staff-led</NOBR> discussions about the enforcement of the Swedish sentence and comparable matters;</P>
<P class="p1097 ft64"><SPAN class="ft2">b.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft115">participation in the Prisoners’ council or its deliberations with the Estonian staff; and</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1098 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">c.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft114">other important activities taking place within the prison, including but not limited to medical visits, dentist visits and contact with religious representatives.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p846 ft64"><SPAN class="ft2">6.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft115">A Prisoner is entitled to additional remuneration, as to be specified in the Memorandum of Cooperation, if the Prisoner:</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1099 ft2">357</P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_358">


<DIV>
<DIV id="id_1">
<P class="p801 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185 Bilaga 2</P>
<P class="p755 ft2">358</P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="id_2">
<P class="p1100 ft2">a. works more than eight hours per day;</P>
<P class="p937 ft2">b. works more than 40 hours per week;</P>
<P class="p936 ft2">c. works on a public holiday; or</P>
<P class="p781 ft64">d. works outside the hours referred to in Article 26.4, unless additional remuneration is provided under points <NOBR>a–c.</NOBR></P>
<P class="p768 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">7.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">A Prisoner is entitled to remuneration if no occupational activity can be assigned to the Prisoner during normal working hours and this is not due to the Prisoner, or if the Prisoner’s work capacity is wholly or partially reduced due to illness. Such remuneration shall not be granted if the Prisoner receives Swedish sickness compensation or activity compensation under the Swedish Social Insurance Code.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p280 ft2"><SPAN class="ft2">8.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft23">A Prisoner who cannot be assigned occupational activities for at least</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1094 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">30</SPAN><SPAN class="ft114">hours per week is entitled to remuneration of no less than EUR 0.8 for each hour that occupational activities cannot be assigned. The level of the remuneration is to be specified in the Memorandum of Cooperation.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p258 ft2"><SPAN class="ft2">9.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft23">Remuneration referred to in this Article may not be subject to distraint.</SPAN></P>
</DIV>
</DIV>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_359">


<TABLE cellpadding=0 cellspacing=0 class="t137">
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td270"><P class="p902 ft19">Article 33</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td50"><P class="p17 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr26 td270"><P class="p902 ft27">Withholding remuneration</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr26 td50"><P class="p17 ft2">Bilaga 2</P></TD>
</TR>
</TABLE>
<P class="p771 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">1.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">The Estonian Prison and Probation Service shall withhold ten (10) per cent of the remuneration referred to in Article 32 for leave and release purposes. In special cases the Estonian Prison and Probation Service may authorise the use of withheld remuneration for other purposes.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p808 ft117"><SPAN class="ft2">2.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft116">If a Prisoner has intentionally damaged property that belongs to or has been made available to the Estonian Prison and Probation Service, the Estonian Prison and Probation Service may, in accordance with Article 56.5, withhold an amount from the remuneration referred to in Article 32 corresponding to the cost of replacing the property or substituting for it in some other way.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1101 ft2">359</P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_360">


<TABLE cellpadding=0 cellspacing=0 class="t88">
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td111"><P class="p17 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td290"><P class="p556 ft19">PART VII</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr4 td111"><P class="p17 ft2">Bilaga 2</P></TD>
	<TD rowspan=2 class="tr2 td290"><P class="p556 ft19">LEAVE AND OTHER TEMPORARY STAYS AWAY FROM THE</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr25 td111"><P class="p17 ft58"> </P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td111"><P class="p17 ft6"> </P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td290"><P class="p556 ft19">PRISON</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr20 td111"><P class="p17 ft6"> </P></TD>
	<TD class="tr20 td290"><P class="p556 ft19">Article 34</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td111"><P class="p17 ft6"> </P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td290"><P class="p556 ft27">General condition</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr20 td111"><P class="p17 ft6"> </P></TD>
	<TD class="tr20 td290"><P class="p556 ft2">Leave and other temporary stays away from the Prison may only be</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td111"><P class="p17 ft6"> </P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td290"><P class="p17 ft2">granted on Swedish territory.</P></TD>
</TR>
</TABLE>
<P class="p904 ft2">360</P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_361">


<TABLE cellpadding=0 cellspacing=0 class="t87">
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td263"><P class="p1102 ft19">Article 35</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td50"><P class="p17 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr26 td263"><P class="p885 ft27">Applications for leave</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr26 td50"><P class="p17 ft2">Bilaga 2</P></TD>
</TR>
</TABLE>
<P class="p771 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">1.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">Leave from the Prison in accordance with Article 36 or 37 may be granted upon application from the Prisoner. The application should be filed with and handled by the Estonian Prison and Probation Service.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p832 ft117"><SPAN class="ft2">2.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft116">If the Estonian Prison and Probation Service concludes that an application for leave may be granted in accordance with Article 36 or 37, the Estonian Prison and Probation Service shall inform the Swedish Prison and Probation Service of its conclusion and of the Prisoner’s application for leave. The Swedish Prison and Probation Service shall review the application and notify the Estonian Prison and Probation Service about its conclusion.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1103 ft117"><SPAN class="ft2">a.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft118">If the Swedish Prison and Probation Service comes to the same conclusion as the Estonian Prison and Probation Service when assessing the application, the Swedish Prison and Probation Service shall immediately decide that the enforcement in Estonia shall cease in accordance with Article 22.2.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p928 ft117"><SPAN class="ft2">b.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft116">If the Swedish Prison and Probation Service comes to a different conclusion than the Estonian Prison and Probation Service when assessing the application, the Estonian Prison and Probation Service shall deny the application.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1104 ft2">361</P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_362">


<TABLE cellpadding=0 cellspacing=0 class="t109">
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td318"><P class="p17 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td319"><P class="p556 ft19">Article 36</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr4 td318"><P class="p17 ft2">Bilaga 2</P></TD>
	<TD rowspan=2 class="tr2 td319"><P class="p556 ft27">Standard leave</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr25 td318"><P class="p17 ft58"> </P></TD>
</TR>
</TABLE>
<P class="p789 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">1.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">To facilitate a Prisoner’s adjustment in the Swedish community, he may be granted permission to stay outside the Prison for a brief period of time (standard leave) if:</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1040 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">a.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft114">at least a </SPAN><NOBR>one-quarter</NOBR> of the Swedish sentence, but at least two months, has been served; and</P>
<P class="p919 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">b.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">there is no manifest risk that the Prisoner will commit crime, evade the full enforcement of the Swedish sentence or otherwise misbehave.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p946 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">2.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">For a Prisoner serving life imprisonment, the period referred to in paragraph 1 shall be determined as if the Swedish sentence is eighteen (18) years.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p873 ft64"><SPAN class="ft2">3.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft115">For special reasons, leave may be granted even though the period referred to in paragraph 1.a has not elapsed.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p946 ft117"><SPAN class="ft2">4.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft116">If the Prisoner is covered by a Swedish decision on the special conditions that are necessary for security reasons, that decision shall be taken into consideration when granting leave in accordance with this Article.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1105 ft2">362</P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_363">


<TABLE cellpadding=0 cellspacing=0 class="t138">
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td320"><P class="p1106 ft19">Article 37</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td50"><P class="p17 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr26 td320"><P class="p1107 ft27">Special leave</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr26 td50"><P class="p17 ft2">Bilaga 2</P></TD>
</TR>
</TABLE>
<P class="p825 ft64"><SPAN class="ft2">1.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft115">For particularly compassionate reasons, a Prisoner may be granted permission to stay outside the Prison for a brief period (special leave) if:</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1097 ft64"><SPAN class="ft2">a.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft113">his need for a stay outside the Prison cannot be met by leave in accordance with Article 36; and</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1098 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">b.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">the stay outside the Prison can be granted having regard to the risk that the Prisoner will commit crime, evade the full enforcement of the Swedish sentence or otherwise misbehave.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p832 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">2.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">If the Prisoner is covered by a Swedish decision on special conditions necessary for security reasons, that decision shall be taken into consideration when granting special leave in accordance with this Article.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1108 ft2">363</P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_364">


<TABLE cellpadding=0 cellspacing=0 class="t139">
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td321"><P class="p17 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td322"><P class="p556 ft19">Article 38</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr4 td321"><P class="p17 ft2">Bilaga 2</P></TD>
	<TD rowspan=2 class="tr2 td322"><P class="p556 ft27">Managing temporary stays away from the Prison</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr25 td321"><P class="p17 ft58"> </P></TD>
</TR>
</TABLE>
<P class="p439 ft2"><SPAN class="ft2">1.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft23">Temporary stays away from the Prison in accordance with Article 39 or</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1109 ft2"><SPAN class="ft2">40</SPAN><SPAN class="ft23">shall be granted without an application from the Prisoner.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p836 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">2.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">If the Estonian Prison and Probation Service concludes that a temporary stay away from the Prison shall be granted in accordance with Article 39 or 40, the Estonian Prison and Probation Service shall inform the Swedish Prison and Probation Service of its conclusion.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1039 ft117"><SPAN class="ft2">a.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft118">If the Estonian Prison and Probation Service concludes that a temporary stay away from the Prison shall be granted in accordance with Article 39 upon request from an Estonian public authority, the Estonian Prison and Probation Service is responsible for the enforcement of the decision. By way of derogation from Article 34, such a decision may be enforced on Estonian territory.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1110 ft117"><SPAN class="ft2">b.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft116">If the Estonian Prison and Probation Service concludes that a temporary stay away from the Prison shall be granted in accordance with Article 39 or 40 upon request from a Swedish public authority, the Swedish Prison and Probation Service is responsible for the enforcement of the decision and shall immediately decide that the enforcement in Estonia shall cease in accordance with Article 22.2.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1111 ft2">364</P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_365">


<TABLE cellpadding=0 cellspacing=0 class="t140">
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td255"><P class="p1046 ft19">Article 39</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td50"><P class="p17 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr26 td255"><P class="p1091 ft27">Appearance before a court or other public authority</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr26 td50"><P class="p17 ft2">Bilaga 2</P></TD>
</TR>
</TABLE>
<P class="p771 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">1.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">A Prisoner may temporarily stay outside the Prison if a public authority in Sweden or Estonia requests that he shall appear in person before it. Such an appearance shall always be granted if it is a court that requests that the Prisoner appear in person before it.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p808 ft117"><SPAN class="ft2">2.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft116">Without prejudice to paragraph 1 and in accordance with Article 12, solutions that make it possible for the Prisoner to appear before a public authority through audio transmission or audio and video transmission should be pursued.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p923 ft2">365</P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_366">


<TABLE cellpadding=0 cellspacing=0 class="t99">
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td111"><P class="p17 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td116"><P class="p581 ft19">Article 40</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr4 td111"><P class="p17 ft2">Bilaga 2</P></TD>
	<TD rowspan=2 class="tr2 td116"><P class="p581 ft3">Assessment of the risk of recidivism</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr25 td111"><P class="p17 ft58"> </P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr20 td111"><P class="p17 ft6"> </P></TD>
	<TD class="tr20 td116"><P class="p581 ft2">A Prisoner who is to undergo an assessment of his risk of recidivism in</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td111"><P class="p17 ft6"> </P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td116"><P class="p581 ft2">accordance with Section 10 of the Swedish Act on the Commutation of</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td111"><P class="p17 ft6"> </P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td116"><P class="p581 ft2">Life Sentences (2006:45) may stay away from the Prison to the extent that</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr26 td111"><P class="p17 ft6"> </P></TD>
	<TD class="tr26 td116"><P class="p556 ft26">the Swedish authority responsible for the assessment considers necessary</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td111"><P class="p17 ft6"> </P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td116"><P class="p17 ft2">for carrying out that assessment.</P></TD>
</TR>
</TABLE>
<P class="p924 ft2">366</P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_367">


<TABLE cellpadding=0 cellspacing=0 class="t141">
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td38"><P class="p1112 ft19">PART VIII</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td50"><P class="p17 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr26 td38"><P class="p1112 ft19">MEDICAL CARE AND DEATH OF A PRISONER</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr26 td50"><P class="p17 ft2">Bilaga 2</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr20 td38"><P class="p1113 ft19">Article 41</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr20 td50"><P class="p17 ft6"> </P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td38"><P class="p1112 ft27">Medical care</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td50"><P class="p17 ft6"> </P></TD>
</TR>
</TABLE>
<P class="p825 ft64"><SPAN class="ft2">1.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft115">Medical care of a Prisoner in Estonia shall be provided by Estonia in accordance with the law and regulations of Estonia.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p771 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">2.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">In connection with the reception of a Prisoner to the Prison, the Prisoner shall be given the opportunity to undergo a medical examination by a healthcare professional in the Prison.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p832 ft64"><SPAN class="ft2">3.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft115">Screenings with the purpose of suicide prevention shall be done in a manner that is to be further specified in the Memorandum of Cooperation.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p825 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">4.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">A Prisoner shall receive medical care, including dental care and advise by an optician as follows:</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1114 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">a.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft114">inside the Prison, in cases where the Prisoner’s medical condition does not require admission to a medical clinic, a dental clinic or an optician’s clinic in accordance with point b;</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1115 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">b.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">outside the Prison in a medical clinic, dental clinic or optician’s clinic in Estonia, in cases where the Prisoner’s medical condition requires temporary admission to such a clinic outside the Prison.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p832 ft117"><SPAN class="ft2">5.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft116">A Prisoner that is restrained with an instrument of restraint shall be examined by a doctor as soon as possible. Awaiting the doctor’s examination, another health care professional shall immediately examine the Prisoner.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p833 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">6.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">If a Prisoner is no longer eligible for enforcement in the Prison due to his medical condition according to Article 20.1.c, he shall be transferred to Sweden as soon as possible.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p808 ft117"><SPAN class="ft2">7.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft116">If a transfer to Sweden according to paragraph 6 is not possible for medical reasons, medical care shall temporarily be provided in Estonia according to paragraph 4.b. The Prisoner shall be transferred to Sweden as soon as the Prisoner’s medical situation allows.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p833 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">8.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">If a Prisoner needs to be transferred to Sweden due to his need for medical care in accordance with paragraph 6, the Swedish Prison and</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1116 ft2">367</P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_368">


<DIV id="id_1">
<DIV id="id_1_1">
<P class="p14 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185 Bilaga 2</P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="id_1_2">
<P class="p1117 ft64">Probation Service shall decide that the enforcement in Estonia shall cease in accordance with Article 22.2.</P>
<P class="p768 ft117"><SPAN class="ft2">9.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft116">Medical or dental products and medicine shall be provided by Estonia in accordance with the law and regulations of Estonia. The Prisoner shall be informed of the generic name of the product or medicine. Exceptionally, medical or dental products and medicine may be provided by Sweden provided that this is in accordance with applicable regulations.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1018 ft64"><SPAN class="ft2">10.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft113">When a Prisoner is transferred to Estonia in accordance with this Agreement, the Swedish Prison and Probation Service shall share the</SPAN></P>
<P class="p19 ft2">Prisoner’s medical record in English and in Swedish with the Prison</P>
<P class="p19 ft2">Health Unit provided that this is in accordance with applicable regulations.</P>
<P class="p65 ft2"><SPAN class="ft2">11.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft20">When a Prisoner is transferred to Sweden in accordance with this</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1118 ft109">Agreement, the Prison Health Unit shall share the Prisoner’s medical record in Swedish with the Swedish Prison and Probation Service provided that this in accordance with applicable regulations.</P>
<P class="p854 ft64"><SPAN class="ft2">12.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft113">When a Prisoner’s medical record is shared in accordance with paragraph 10 or 11, the following documents shall be included:</SPAN></P>
<P class="p936 ft2"><SPAN class="ft2">a.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft20">medical records;</SPAN></P>
<P class="p937 ft2"><SPAN class="ft2">b.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft20">prescriptions;</SPAN></P>
<P class="p936 ft2"><SPAN class="ft2">c.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft20">medical opinions;</SPAN></P>
<P class="p937 ft2"><SPAN class="ft2">d.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft20">medical certificates; and</SPAN></P>
<P class="p937 ft2"><SPAN class="ft2">e.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft20">other documents that may be of importance when assessing a</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1119 ft64">Prisoner’s health, including but not limited to documentation of rehabilitation.</P>
<P class="p1120 ft64"><SPAN class="ft2">13.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft113">The documents referred to in paragraph 12 shall continuously be made available to the Prisoner in Swedish.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1120 ft64"><SPAN class="ft2">14.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft113">The cost of care in accordance with paragraph 4 and provided by Estonia shall be covered by the fee referred to in Articles 51 and 52.</SPAN></P>
</DIV>
</DIV>
<DIV id="id_2">
<P class="p14 ft2">368</P>
</DIV>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_369">


<TABLE cellpadding=0 cellspacing=0 class="t142">
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td323"><P class="p1121 ft19">Article 42</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td50"><P class="p17 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr26 td323"><P class="p1122 ft27">Death of a Prisoner, suicide attempts and other <NOBR>self-harming</NOBR> actions or</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr26 td50"><P class="p17 ft2">Bilaga 2</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td323"><P class="p1122 ft27">behaviours</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td50"><P class="p17 ft6"> </P></TD>
</TR>
</TABLE>
<P class="p808 ft117"><SPAN class="ft2">1.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft116">In the event of death, suicide attempts or other </SPAN><NOBR>self-harming</NOBR> actions or behaviours of a Prisoner during the enforcement in the Prison, the Estonian Prison and Probation Service shall immediately inform the Swedish Prison and Probation Service. This obligation is without prejudice to Estonia’s obligations under Article 37 of the Vienna Convention on Consular Relations.</P>
<P class="p834 ft64"><SPAN class="ft2">2.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft115">The Estonian Prison and Probations Service shall report the event to the relevant authorities in Estonia.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p771 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">3.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">The remains of the deceased shall be allowed to be transported on the orders of the relevant authorities in Estonia for further examination of the cause of death.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p832 ft117"><SPAN class="ft2">4.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft116">The Swedish Prison and Probation Service and the Estonian Prison and Probation Service share the responsibility to arrange for the transfer of the remains of the deceased to Sweden or to a third country, as soon as possible.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p931 ft117"><SPAN class="ft2">5.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft116">Administrative and supervisory inquiries in the Prison regarding the events mentioned in paragraph 1 may be conducted by relevant Swedish authorities in accordance with the law and regulations of Sweden. If requested, Estonia shall provide relevant Swedish authorities with information of ongoing investigations and prosecution results.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1123 ft2">369</P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_370">


<TABLE cellpadding=0 cellspacing=0 class="t88">
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td111"><P class="p17 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td290"><P class="p556 ft19">PART IX</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr4 td111"><P class="p17 ft2">Bilaga 2</P></TD>
	<TD rowspan=2 class="tr2 td290"><P class="p556 ft19">INFORMATION EXCHANGE</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr25 td111"><P class="p17 ft58"> </P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr20 td111"><P class="p17 ft6"> </P></TD>
	<TD class="tr20 td290"><P class="p556 ft19">Article 43</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td111"><P class="p17 ft6"> </P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td290"><P class="p556 ft27">Information in connection with the commencement of the enforcement in</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td111"><P class="p17 ft6"> </P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td290"><P class="p787 ft27">Estonia</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr20 td111"><P class="p17 ft6"> </P></TD>
	<TD class="tr20 td290"><P class="p556 ft2">In connection with the commencement of the enforcement in Estonia, the</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td111"><P class="p17 ft6"> </P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td290"><P class="p556 ft2">Swedish Prison and Probation Service shall provide the Estonian Prison</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr26 td111"><P class="p17 ft6"> </P></TD>
	<TD class="tr26 td290"><P class="p556 ft2">and Probation Service with all necessary information, as to be further</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td111"><P class="p17 ft6"> </P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td290"><P class="p17 ft2">specified in the Memorandum of Cooperation.</P></TD>
</TR>
</TABLE>
<P class="p1124 ft2">370</P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_371">


<TABLE cellpadding=0 cellspacing=0 class="t143">
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td16"><P class="p1125 ft19">Article 44</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td50"><P class="p17 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr26 td16"><P class="p1126 ft27">Information during the enforcement in Estonia</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr26 td50"><P class="p17 ft2">Bilaga 2</P></TD>
</TR>
</TABLE>
<P class="p771 ft117"><SPAN class="ft2">1.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft116">The Estonian Prison and Probation Service shall immediately report any serious incident regarding the security of the Prison to the Swedish Prison and Probation Service. The Estonian Prison and Probation Service shall also immediately report to the Swedish Prison and Probation Service regarding any media coverage of the Prison.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p833 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">2.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">The Estonian Prison and Probation Service shall report on a regular basis to the Swedish Prison and Probation Service any legal actions regarding Prisoners during the enforcement of a Swedish sentence in the Prison.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p808 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">3.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">The Estonian Prison and Probation Service shall inform the Swedish Prison and Probation Service about requests for judicial cooperation from third countries concerning the Prisoner.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p832 ft117"><SPAN class="ft2">4.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft116">The Estonian Prison and Probation Service shall provide copies of complaints from Prisoners in matters when the law and regulations of Estonia is applicable according to Article 6.1, to the Swedish Prison and Probation Service.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p931 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">5.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">If requested by the Swedish Prison and Probation Service, the Estonian Prison and Probation Service shall provide other information regarding the enforcement in Estonia.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1127 ft2">371</P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_372">


<TABLE cellpadding=0 cellspacing=0 class="t99">
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td111"><P class="p17 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td116"><P class="p581 ft19">Article 45</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr4 td111"><P class="p17 ft2">Bilaga 2</P></TD>
	<TD rowspan=2 class="tr2 td116"><P class="p581 ft27">Information in connection with the cease of the enforcement in Estonia</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr25 td111"><P class="p17 ft58"> </P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr20 td111"><P class="p17 ft6"> </P></TD>
	<TD class="tr20 td116"><P class="p581 ft26">Before the transportation from Estonia to Sweden the Estonian Prison and</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td111"><P class="p17 ft6"> </P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td116"><P class="p556 ft2">Probation Service shall provide the Swedish Prison and Probation Service</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td111"><P class="p17 ft6"> </P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td116"><P class="p581 ft2">with information about the enforcement in the Prison necessary for the</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr26 td111"><P class="p17 ft6"> </P></TD>
	<TD class="tr26 td116"><P class="p17 ft2">continuation of the enforcement in Sweden.</P></TD>
</TR>
</TABLE>
<P class="p944 ft2">372</P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_373">


<TABLE cellpadding=0 cellspacing=0 class="t6">
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td90"><P class="p970 ft19">Article 46</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td50"><P class="p17 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr26 td90"><P class="p867 ft27">Confidentiality</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr26 td50"><P class="p17 ft2">Bilaga 2</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr20 td90"><P class="p867 ft2">All information exchanged under this Agreement shall be treated by the</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr20 td50"><P class="p17 ft6"> </P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td90"><P class="p17 ft2">Parties in a secure and confidential manner.</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td50"><P class="p17 ft6"> </P></TD>
</TR>
</TABLE>
<P class="p945 ft2">373</P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_374">


<TABLE cellpadding=0 cellspacing=0 class="t144">
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td125"><P class="p17 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td142"><P class="p556 ft19">PART X</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr4 td125"><P class="p17 ft2">Bilaga 2</P></TD>
	<TD rowspan=2 class="tr2 td142"><P class="p556 ft19">IMMUNITIES AND PRIVILIGES ETC.</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr25 td125"><P class="p17 ft58"> </P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr20 td125"><P class="p17 ft6"> </P></TD>
	<TD class="tr20 td142"><P class="p556 ft19">Article 47</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td125"><P class="p17 ft6"> </P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td142"><P class="p556 ft27">Prisoner supervision, inquiries, complaints and legal actions</P></TD>
</TR>
</TABLE>
<P class="p789 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">1.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">Supervision and the implementation of the enforcement of Swedish sentences is governed by the law and regulations of Estonia with respect to this Agreement and the Memorandum of Cooperation as set out in Article 6.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p817 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">2.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">The Swedish Prison and Probation Service shall have the right to monitor the proper enforcement of sentences, in regard to which it shall have access as referred to in Articles 7 and 24.7 of this Agreement.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p946 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">3.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">International bodies, such as the European Committee for the Prevention of Torture and Inhuman or Degrading Treatment or Punishment, are authorised to conduct announced and unannounced visits to the Prison and with respect to transport under Article 24 and transfer and treatment under Article 41. They shall be granted access to information and be allowed to interview Prisoners to the greatest extent possible by Estonia.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1128 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">4.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">The relevant Estonian authorities may conduct inquiries related to the law and regulations of Estonia where applicable in accordance with this Agreement and the mandate of these authorities.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1129 ft117"><SPAN class="ft2">5.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft116">Estonian lawyers and other legal representatives may be permitted to provide legal services in the Prison according to the law and regulations of Estonia. Such a permission shall be decided by the Estonian Prison and Probation Service in accordance with the law and regulations of Estonia.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1130 ft117"><SPAN class="ft2">6.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft116">Lawyers and legal representatives other than those referred to in paragraph 5, and </SPAN><NOBR>non-governmental</NOBR> organisations providing legal services may be permitted to provide legal services in the Prison or by contacting a Prisoner through audio transmission or audio and video transmission. Such a permission shall be decided by the Swedish Prison and Probation Service in accordance with the law and regulations of Sweden.</P>
<P class="p1052 ft64"><SPAN class="ft2">7.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft115">A visit by a lawyer who is assisting the Prisoner in a legal matter may only be monitored if the lawyer or the Prisoner requests it.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1131 ft2">374</P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_375">


<TABLE cellpadding=0 cellspacing=0 class="t145">
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td324"><P class="p770 ft19">Article 48</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td50"><P class="p17 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr26 td324"><P class="p1132 ft3">Immunity of the Swedish staff</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr26 td50"><P class="p17 ft2">Bilaga 2</P></TD>
</TR>
</TABLE>
<P class="p825 ft64"><SPAN class="ft2">1.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft115">The Swedish staff enjoy immunity from Estonian jurisdiction in respect of acts performed in the exercise of their duties.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p771 ft117"><SPAN class="ft2">2.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft116">The immunity provided for in paragraph 1 is granted in the interests of the proper implementation of this Agreement and not for the personal benefit of the Swedish staff. Sweden shall, </SPAN><SPAN class="ft128">ex officio </SPAN>or at the request of Estonia, waive the immunity of the Swedish staff in any case where it would impede the course of justice not to do so and where the immunity may be waived without prejudice to the purpose for which it is afforded.</P>
<P class="p841 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">3.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">The immunity provided for in paragraph 1 shall not exclude the Swedish staff from Swedish jurisdiction.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p832 ft117"><SPAN class="ft2">4.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft116">Regardless of where they are located, all files, documents, and other data carriers of Sweden that the Swedish staff have in their possession in the exercise of their duties shall be inviolable. Estonia may request access to relevant documents.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p834 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">5.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">Immunity regarding property, assets and other relevant items shall be further specified in the Memorandum of Cooperation.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p832 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">6.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">Salaries, wages and similar remuneration paid by the Swedish Prison and Probation Service to Swedish staff shall be exempt from taxation in Estonia.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1133 ft2">375</P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_376">


<TABLE cellpadding=0 cellspacing=0 class="t146">
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td325"><P class="p17 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td96"><P class="p581 ft19">Article 49</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr4 td325"><P class="p17 ft2">Bilaga 2</P></TD>
	<TD rowspan=2 class="tr2 td96"><P class="p556 ft3">Income tax for Prisoners</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr25 td325"><P class="p17 ft58"> </P></TD>
</TR>
</TABLE>
<P class="p836 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">1.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">Time spent by a Prisoner on Estonian territory for the purpose of serving a Swedish sentence, shall not be considered time spent in Estonia for the purpose of determining his tax liability in Estonia by reason of domicile, residence or any other criterion of a similar nature.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p873 ft64"><SPAN class="ft2">2.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft115">Paragraph 1 shall only apply if the Prisoner upon commencing the Swedish sentence:</SPAN></P>
<P class="p816 ft64"><SPAN class="ft2">a.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft113">is liable to tax in Sweden by reason of his domicile, residence, or any other criterion of a similar nature; and</SPAN></P>
<P class="p883 ft2"><SPAN class="ft2">b.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft20">is not liable to tax Estonia by any such reason.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p843 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">3.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">Remuneration referred to in Article 32 shall be exempt from taxation in Estonia.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p951 ft2">376</P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_377">


<TABLE cellpadding=0 cellspacing=0 class="t147">
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td29"><P class="p1134 ft19">PART XI</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td50"><P class="p17 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr26 td29"><P class="p1134 ft19">COSTS</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr26 td50"><P class="p17 ft2">Bilaga 2</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr20 td29"><P class="p1135 ft19">Article 50</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr20 td50"><P class="p17 ft6"> </P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td29"><P class="p1134 ft3">Upon entry</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td50"><P class="p17 ft6"> </P></TD>
</TR>
</TABLE>
<P class="p771 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">1.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">Estonia will cover the costs for the necessary adaption, preparation and equipment of the Prison according to the standards and legal requirements in this Agreement.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p832 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">2.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">The adaptions necessary shall be decided in dialogue between the Swedish Prison and Probation Service and the Estonian Prison and Probation Service.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1136 ft2">377</P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_378">


<TABLE cellpadding=0 cellspacing=0 class="t148">
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td326"><P class="p17 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td327"><P class="p556 ft19">Article 51</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr4 td326"><P class="p17 ft2">Bilaga 2</P></TD>
	<TD rowspan=2 class="tr2 td327"><P class="p556 ft27">At full capacity</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr25 td326"><P class="p17 ft58"> </P></TD>
</TR>
</TABLE>
<P class="p836 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">1.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">Estonia shall guarantee full availability of the total number of prison places as specified in Article 13.1 no later than twelve (12) months after this Agreement’s entry into force.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p692 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">2.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">After the transitional period referred to in Article 52, Sweden shall pay an annual fixed fee of EUR 30 600 000 for the availability of capacity for</SPAN></P>
<P class="p958 ft64"><SPAN class="ft2">300</SPAN><SPAN class="ft113">Prisoners six months in advance in biannual instalments, each amounting to 50 per cent of the applicable annual fee.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p836 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">3.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">Capacity used in addition to that paid for in accordance with paragraph 2 shall be calculated monthly and shall be paid by Sweden in arrears at a cost of EUR 8 500 per month per Prisoner.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p959 ft2">378</P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_379">


<TABLE cellpadding=0 cellspacing=0 class="t149">
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td271"><P class="p1137 ft19">Article 52</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td50"><P class="p17 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr26 td271"><P class="p1137 ft27">Transitional period</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr26 td50"><P class="p17 ft2">Bilaga 2</P></TD>
</TR>
</TABLE>
<P class="p821 ft117"><SPAN class="ft2">1.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft116">The total number of cells for single occupancy specified in Article 13.1 shall be made available gradually over a transition period of twelve (12) months from this Agreement’s entry into force. The transition period shall be divided into four quarters and the capacity shall be made available according to paragraphs </SPAN><NOBR>2–5.</NOBR></P>
<P class="p1138 ft2"><SPAN class="ft2">2.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft23">At the start of the first quarter after this Agreement’s entry into force,</SPAN></P>
<P class="p695 ft109">Estonia shall guarantee 25 per cent availability of the capacity referred to in paragraph 1 (100 cells).</P>
<P class="p3 ft2"><SPAN class="ft2">3.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft23">At the start of the second quarter after this Agreement’s entry into force,</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1074 ft64">Estonia shall guarantee 50 per cent availability of the capacity referred to in paragraph 1 (200 cells).</P>
<P class="p342 ft2"><SPAN class="ft2">4.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft23">At the start of the third quarter after this Agreement’s entry into force,</SPAN></P>
<P class="p695 ft109">Estonia shall guarantee 75 per cent availability of the capacity referred to in paragraph 1 (300 cells).</P>
<P class="p3 ft2"><SPAN class="ft2">5.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft23">At the start of the fourth quarter after this Agreement’s entry into force,</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1074 ft64">Estonia shall guarantee 100 per cent availability of the capacity referred to in paragraph 1 (400 cells).</P>
<P class="p821 ft64"><SPAN class="ft2">6.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft115">The fixed fee for the transitional period shall be EUR 22 950 000 and shall be paid by Sweden in advance no later than 2 months after this</SPAN></P>
<P class="p775 ft2">Agreement’s entry into force.</P>
<P class="p821 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">7.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">In the fourth quarter referred to in paragraph 5, the cost of any cells used in addition to the 300 cells referred to in paragraph 4 shall be calculated monthly and be paid in arrears at a cost of EUR 8 500 per month per Prisoner.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1051 ft2">379</P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_380">


<TABLE cellpadding=0 cellspacing=0 class="t88">
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td111"><P class="p17 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td290"><P class="p556 ft19">Article 53</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr4 td111"><P class="p17 ft2">Bilaga 2</P></TD>
	<TD rowspan=2 class="tr2 td290"><P class="p787 ft27">Costs for unanticipated stays in Estonia</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr25 td111"><P class="p17 ft58"> </P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr20 td111"><P class="p17 ft6"> </P></TD>
	<TD class="tr20 td290"><P class="p556 ft2">Sweden shall compensate costs related to a Prisoner’s unanticipated stay</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td111"><P class="p17 ft6"> </P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td290"><P class="p556 ft2">in Estonia arising from an asylum process or from investigation of an</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td111"><P class="p17 ft6"> </P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td290"><P class="p556 ft2">alleged criminal offence. This applies to costs arising until the asylum</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr26 td111"><P class="p17 ft6"> </P></TD>
	<TD class="tr26 td290"><P class="p556 ft2">claim or the investigation of an alleged criminal offence are subject to a</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td111"><P class="p17 ft6"> </P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td290"><P class="p17 ft2">final decision by an Estonian public authority.</P></TD>
</TR>
</TABLE>
<P class="p924 ft2">380</P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_381">


<TABLE cellpadding=0 cellspacing=0 class="t6">
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td90"><P class="p970 ft19">Article 54</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td50"><P class="p17 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr26 td90"><P class="p867 ft27">Indexation</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr26 td50"><P class="p17 ft2">Bilaga 2</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr20 td90"><P class="p867 ft2">The fees listed in Article 51 shall be indexed annually to a fixed indexation</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr20 td50"><P class="p17 ft6"> </P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td90"><P class="p17 ft2">rate of 3.5 per cent starting 1 January 2027.</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td50"><P class="p17 ft6"> </P></TD>
</TR>
</TABLE>
<P class="p945 ft2">381</P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_382">


<TABLE cellpadding=0 cellspacing=0 class="t150">
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td88"><P class="p17 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td55"><P class="p556 ft19">PART XII</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr4 td88"><P class="p17 ft2">Bilaga 2</P></TD>
	<TD rowspan=2 class="tr2 td55"><P class="p556 ft19">FINAL PROVISIONS</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr25 td88"><P class="p17 ft58"> </P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr20 td88"><P class="p17 ft6"> </P></TD>
	<TD class="tr20 td55"><P class="p556 ft19">Article 55</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td88"><P class="p17 ft6"> </P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td55"><P class="p556 ft27">Entry into force and duration of this Agreement</P></TD>
</TR>
</TABLE>
<P class="p827 ft117"><SPAN class="ft2">1.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft116">This Agreement shall be subject to ratification by the Parties. The Parties shall notify each other in writing through diplomatic channels once the national legal procedures necessary for the entry into force of this Agreement have been completed. This Agreement shall enter into force on the thirtieth day following the receipt of the latter of these notifications.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p837 ft64"><SPAN class="ft2">2.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft115">This Agreement shall remain in force for five (5) years after its entry into force.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p789 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">3.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">The duration of this Agreement shall be automatically extended for additional periods of three (3) years at a time unless either of the Parties notifies the other of its intention to terminate this Agreement. Such notification shall be made at least twelve (12) months before:</SPAN></P>
<P class="p859 ft2"><SPAN class="ft2">a.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft20">the end of the period referred to in paragraph 2; or</SPAN></P>
<P class="p859 ft2"><SPAN class="ft2">b.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft20">the end of an additional period as set out in this paragraph.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1139 ft2">382</P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_383">


<TABLE cellpadding=0 cellspacing=0 class="t126">
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td222"><P class="p839 ft19">Article 56</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td50"><P class="p17 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr26 td222"><P class="p1055 ft27">Liability</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr26 td50"><P class="p17 ft2">Bilaga 2</P></TD>
</TR>
</TABLE>
<P class="p771 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">1.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">Any failure to comply with this Agreement and obligations deriving therefrom, shall oblige the failing Party to provide satisfaction to the other Party for all damage resulting therefrom.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p832 ft117"><SPAN class="ft2">2.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft116">A Party shall be liable for the actions, omissions, or other conduct of a third Party which that Party has recourse to in order to fulfil that Party’s obligations under this Agreement and obligations deriving therefrom in the same way as that Party is liable for its own actions, omissions or other conduct.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1140 ft121"><SPAN class="ft2">3.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft120">Any personal damage to the Prisoner caused through fault or negligence by the Estonian staff shall be borne by Estonia. This also includes compensation for any violation of the Prisoner’s personal integrity.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p808 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">4.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">Any damage, costs or loss to the Prison and its movable and immovable property caused by a Prisoner through normal use or otherwise shall be borne by Estonia. The same applies to any damage to the Estonian staff caused by a Prisoner.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p808 ft117"><SPAN class="ft2">5.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft116">In the event of an escape of a Prisoner, any damage, costs or loss caused by the Prisoner shall be borne by Estonia. The same applies to any damage, costs or loss caused by the Prisoner during granted temporary stays away from the Prison enforced on Estonian territory.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1140 ft64"><SPAN class="ft2">6.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft115">Notwithstanding the foregoing, the Parties acknowledge that a Prisoner, under the laws of Estonia may be personally liable for intentional damages.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1141 ft2">383</P>
</DIV>

<P class="p836 ft117"><SPAN class="ft2">1.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft116">If an event giving rise to an instance of force majeure occurs and prevents the partial or complete fulfilment of this Agreement, the relevant Party must notify the other Party of the relevant facts in writing as soon as possible. After receipt of the notification, the Parties shall enter into dialogue in order to determine if this Agreement and obligations deriving therefrom may be amended under acceptable terms.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p724 ft117"><SPAN class="ft2">2.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft116">An instance of force majeure means all circumstances beyond the reasonable control of the Party concerned, including but not limited to natural disasters, war, riots, civil disturbances, fires, explosions, terrorism, sabotage, strikes, lockouts, labour disturbances, accidents, epidemics, pandemics, breakdowns of public utilities, orders or decrees of any court and extraordinary actions by third parties.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p966 ft2">384</P>
</DIV>

<P class="p771 ft117"><SPAN class="ft2">1.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft116">The Parties shall take the necessary measures to ensure full compliance with this Agreement. Any breach in the implementation of this Agreement by Estonia identified by the Swedish Prison and Probation Service and communicated to the Estonian Prison and Probation Service shall be immediately addressed.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p833 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">2.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">Any disputes arising from the enforcement of this Agreement shall primarily be solved via consultations between the Swedish Prison and Probation Service and the Estonian Prison and Probation Service.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p832 ft117"><SPAN class="ft2">3.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft116">If a dispute cannot be resolved in accordance with paragraph 2, the Parties shall consult on the implementation of this Agreement if necessary. Any differences or disputes concerning the interpretation or implementation of this Agreement shall be settled through negotiations between the Parties.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1143 ft2">385</P>
</DIV>

<P class="p836 ft117"><SPAN class="ft2">1.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft116">Notwithstanding Article 55, this Agreement may be terminated by either Party at any time by written notification to the other Party through diplomatic channels. In the event of termination of this Agreement, the Agreement shall expire twelve (12) months after the receipt of such notification.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1144 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">2.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">After receiving a notification for termination of this Agreement, the Parties shall immediately initiate consultations to specify the terms and conditions of ceasing the enforcement of Swedish sentences in the Prison.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p692 ft109"><SPAN class="ft2">3.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft112">Termination of this Agreement shall not affect any rights or obligations arising out of the execution of this Agreement and the Memorandum of Cooperation before such termination.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p946 ft117"><SPAN class="ft2">4.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft116">In the event of termination of this Agreement, personal data that has been received by Estonia from Sweden shall, if deemed necessary by Sweden, continue to be processed in accordance with the rules referred to in Article 3.2 or otherwise be returned or erased in accordance with instructions from the Swedish Prison and Probation Service.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1130 ft121"><SPAN class="ft2">5.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft120">On termination of this Agreement, the Parties shall ensure that the enforcement of Swedish sentences in the Prison ends and that no Prisoners or property brought into the Prison by Sweden remain in the Prison.</SPAN></P>

<DIV id="page_389">


<DIV id="id_1">
<DIV id="id_1_1">
<P class="p14 ft1">Sammanfattning av promemorian</P>
<P class="p1147 ft1">Tillfällig verkställighet av svenska fängelsestraff utomlands (Ju2025/01973)</P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="id_1_2">
<P class="p14 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185 Bilaga 3</P>
</DIV>
</DIV>
<DIV id="id_2">
<P class="p693 ft2">I promemorian lämnas förslag till en ny lag om tillfällig verkställighet av svenska fängelsestraff utomlands. Den nya lagen möjliggör att svenska fängelsestraff under viss tid kan verkställas i en kriminalvårdsanstalt utomlands. Syftet med förslagen är att bidra till att avhjälpa den allvarliga platsbristen inom Kriminalvården. Förslagen har tagits fram med anledning av det avtal som Sverige och Estland undertecknade den 18 juni 2025 om verkställighet av svenska fängelsestraff i Estland. Lagen föreslås dock vara generellt utformad för att kunna tillämpas i förhållande till samtliga stater som Sverige har eller kan komma att ingå denna typ av överenskommelse med.</P>
<P class="p9 ft2">Den nya lagen innehåller bestämmelser om bl.a. Kriminalvårdens handläggning, urvalet av intagna som kan komma i fråga för verkställighet utomlands, permissioner, försändelser, upphörande av verkställigheten och möjligheten att överklaga beslut.</P>
<P class="p191 ft2">Promemorian innehåller även förslag och bedömningar i frågor som rör bl.a. migrationsrätt, skadeståndsrätt, arbetsrätt, socialrätt och skatterätt.</P>
<P class="p191 ft2">Vidare lämnas förslag till en ny förordning som kompletterar den nya lagen samt förslag till ändringar i andra förordningar.</P>
<P class="p191 ft2">I promemorian föreslås också att riksdagen ska godkänna avtalet mellan Sverige och Estland om verkställighet av svenska fängelsestraff i Estland.</P>
<P class="p194 ft2">Författningsförslagen föreslås träda i kraft den 1 juli 2026.</P>
<P class="p1148 ft2">389</P>
</DIV>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_390">


<DIV id="id_1">
<DIV id="id_1_1">
<P class="p14 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185 Bilaga 4</P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="id_1_2">
<P class="p14 ft1">Promemorians lagförslag</P>
<P class="p1149 ft17">Förslag till lag om tillfällig verkställighet av svenska fängelsestraff utomlands</P>
<P class="p392 ft2">Härigenom föreskrivs följande.</P>
</DIV>
</DIV>
<DIV id="id_2">
<P class="p498 ft18">Lagens innehåll och tillämpningsområde</P>
<P class="p1150 ft2"><SPAN class="ft19">1 § </SPAN>Denna lag innehåller bestämmelser om tillfällig verkställighet av svenska fängelsestraff i en kriminalvårdsanstalt utomlands.</P>
<P class="p724 ft2"><SPAN class="ft19">2 § </SPAN>Lagen ska tillämpas om en internationell överenskommelse har träffats mellan Sverige och en annan stat om verkställighet av svenska fängelsestraff utomlands och riksdagen har beslutat att överlåta rättskipnings- eller förvaltningsuppgift till den andra staten i enlighet med överenskommelsen.</P>
<P class="p1151 ft18">Framställning om tillfällig verkställighet av ett svenskt fängelsestraff utomlands</P>
<P class="p1152 ft19">Beslut om framställning</P>
<P class="p438 ft2"><SPAN class="ft19">3 § </SPAN>Kriminalvården får besluta att göra en framställning till en annan stat (den mottagande staten) om att ett svenskt fängelsestraff tillfälligt ska verkställas i en kriminalvårdsanstalt i den staten enligt denna lag, om inte annat följer av 6 och 7 §§. Beslutet gäller omedelbart.</P>
<P class="p442 ft2">Av beslutet ska det framgå vid vilken tidpunkt den tillfälliga verkställigheten enligt denna lag ska upphöra. Tidpunkten får inte bestämmas till senare än en månad före den tidigaste dagen för villkorlig frigivning enligt den intagnes strafftidsbeslut enligt strafftidslagen (2018:1251).</P>
<P class="p532 ft2">Ett beslut om framställning får inte fattas innan domen där fängelsestraffet dömts ut fått laga kraft i alla delar som gäller ansvar.</P>
<P class="p666 ft2">Framställningen ska sändas till den behöriga myndigheten i den mottagande staten.</P>
<P class="p724 ft2"><SPAN class="ft19">4 § </SPAN>Kriminalvården får besluta att göra en förnyad framställning enligt 3 § om det finns skäl att senarelägga tidpunkten för när den tillfälliga verkställigheten enligt denna lag ska upphöra.</P>
<P class="p724 ft2"><SPAN class="ft19">5 § </SPAN>Vid bedömningen av om en framställning om tillfällig verkställighet av ett svenskt fängelsestraff i en kriminalvårdsanstalt utomlands ska göras, ska Kriminalvården ta hänsyn till den intagnes anknytning till Sverige, den intagnes vårdbehov och övriga omständigheter som kan påverka lämpligheten av en tillfällig verkställighet i en kriminalvårdsanstalt utomlands.</P>
<P class="p532 ft2">I den utsträckning det är möjligt ska hänsyn även tas till den intagnes behov av sysselsättning och en lämplig frigivningsplanering.</P>
<P class="p14 ft2">390</P>
</DIV>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_391">


<DIV>
<DIV id="id_1">
<P class="p14 ft19">När en framställning inte får göras</P>
<P class="p317 ft2"><SPAN class="ft19">6 § </SPAN>En framställning om tillfällig verkställighet av ett svenskt fängelsestraff i en kriminalvårdsanstalt utomlands får inte göras om den intagne</P>
<P class="p70 ft2"><SPAN class="ft2">1.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft20">är under 18 år,</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1153 ft2"><SPAN class="ft2">2.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft20">är efterlyst för utlämning eller överlämnande eller har begärts utlämnad eller överlämnad enligt</SPAN></P>
<P class="p67 ft2">– lagen (1957:668) om utlämning för brott,</P>
<P class="p1154 ft2">– lagen (1994:569) om Sveriges samarbete med de internationella tribunalerna för brott mot internationell humanitär rätt,</P>
<P class="p1153 ft2">– lagen (2002:329) om samarbete med Internationella brottmålsdomstolen,</P>
<P class="p1153 ft2">– lagen (2003:1156) om överlämnande från Sverige enligt en europeisk arresteringsorder,</P>
<P class="p1153 ft2">– lagen (2006:615) om samarbete med Specialdomstolen för Sierra Leone,</P>
<P class="p1154 ft2">– lagen (2011:1165) om överlämnande från Sverige enligt en nordisk arresteringsorder, eller</P>
<P class="p356 ft2">– avtalet om handel och samarbete mellan Europeiska unionen och Europeiska atomenergigemenskapen, å ena sidan, och Förenade konungariket Storbritannien och Nordirland, å andra sidan,</P>
<P class="p1153 ft2"><SPAN class="ft2">3.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft20">har dömts till rättspsykiatrisk vård enligt lagen (1991:1129) om rättspsykiatrisk vård eller i övrigt ges vård med stöd av den lagen,</SPAN></P>
<P class="p70 ft2"><SPAN class="ft2">4.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft20">har dömts för brott enligt terroristbrottslagen (2022:666),</SPAN></P>
<P class="p67 ft2"><SPAN class="ft2">5.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft20">har dömts för brott enligt 18 eller 19 kap. brottsbalken,</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1154 ft2"><SPAN class="ft2">6.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft20">är eller har varit part i ett mål eller ärende enligt lagen (2022:700) om särskild kontroll av vissa utlänningar,</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1153 ft2"><SPAN class="ft2">7.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft20">är eller har varit föremål för prövning i ett säkerhetsärende enligt utlänningslagen (2005:716), eller</SPAN></P>
<P class="p70 ft2"><SPAN class="ft2">8.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft20">i övrigt bedöms utgöra en allvarlig säkerhetsrisk.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p384 ft2">En framställning om tillfällig verkställighet av ett svenskt fängelsestraff i en kriminalvårdsanstalt utomlands får inte heller göras om det strider mot en internationell överenskommelse om verkställighet av svenska fängelsestraff utomlands.</P>
<P class="p796 ft2"><SPAN class="ft19">7 § </SPAN>En framställning om tillfällig verkställighet av ett svenskt fängelsestraff i en kriminalvårdsanstalt utomlands får inte göras om en sådan verkställighet skulle innebära att en intagen underkastas mer ingripande övervakning eller kontroll än vad som är nödvändigt för att ordningen eller säkerheten ska kunna upprätthållas.</P>
<P class="p70 ft2">Vid bedömningen enligt första stycket ska följande särskilt beaktas</P>
<P class="p1153 ft2"><SPAN class="ft2">1.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft20">risken för rymning, fritagning, fortsatt brottslighet, missbruk och annan misskötsamhet, och</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1154 ft2"><SPAN class="ft2">2.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft20">behovet av att undvika en olämplig sammansättning av intagna och att i övrigt kunna bedriva en ändamålsenlig verksamhet i anstalt.</SPAN></P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="id_2">
<P class="p63 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185 Bilaga 4</P>
<P class="p753 ft2">391</P>
</DIV>
</DIV>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_392">


<DIV id="id_1">
<DIV id="id_1_1">
<P class="p14 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185 Bilaga 4</P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="id_1_2">
<P class="p1155 ft18">Påbörjande av tillfällig verkställighet av ett svenskt fängelsestraff utomlands</P>
<P class="p1156 ft2"><SPAN class="ft19">8 § </SPAN>Efter att en framställning enligt 3 § har beviljats av den mottagande staten ska Kriminalvården överföra den intagne till den staten.</P>
<P class="p289 ft2">Tillfällig verkställighet av ett svenskt fängelsestraff i en kriminalvårdsanstalt utomlands enligt denna lag påbörjas när den intagne anländer till den mottagande staten.</P>
</DIV>
</DIV>
<DIV id="id_2">
<P class="p498 ft18">Särskilda villkor för långtidsdömda</P>
<P class="p521 ft2"><SPAN class="ft19">9 § </SPAN>Bestämmelserna i 1 kap. 7 § fängelselagen (2010:610) ska gälla vid tillfällig verkställighet av ett svenskt fängelsestraff i en kriminalvårdsanstalt utomlands enligt denna lag.</P>
<P class="p666 ft2">Kriminalvårdens prövning av vilka särskilda villkor som ska gälla för verkställigheten ska göras när behov av det uppstår. Villkoren ska omprövas när det finns anledning till det.</P>
<P class="p437 ft18">Permission och särskild permission</P>
<P class="p1157 ft2"><SPAN class="ft19">10 § </SPAN>En ansökan om permission eller särskild permission enligt denna lag ska göras hos den behöriga myndigheten i den mottagande staten.</P>
<P class="p724 ft2"><SPAN class="ft19">11 § </SPAN>Om den behöriga myndigheten i den mottagande staten bedömer att en ansökan om permission eller särskild permission kan beviljas, ska Kriminalvården pröva om det finns förutsättningar att bevilja permission eller särskild permission enligt denna lag.</P>
<P class="p532 ft2">Kriminalvårdens beslut enligt första stycket gäller omedelbart, om inte något annat beslutas.</P>
<P class="p724 ft2"><SPAN class="ft19">12 § </SPAN>Bestämmelserna i 10 kap. 1 och 2 §§ fängelselagen (2010:610) ska gälla vid Kriminalvårdens prövning enligt 11 §.</P>
<P class="p724 ft2"><SPAN class="ft19">13 § </SPAN>Om Kriminalvården har fattat ett beslut om särskilda villkor för långtidsdömda enligt 9 § eller 1 kap. 7 § fängelselagen (2010:610), får ett beslut enligt 11 § första stycket inte meddelas i strid med de villkoren.</P>
<P class="p437 ft18">Försändelser</P>
<P class="p525 ft2"><SPAN class="ft19">14 § </SPAN>Kriminalvården ansvarar för att intagna vars svenska fängelsestraff tillfälligt verkställs i en kriminalvårdsanstalt utomlands enligt denna lag kan skicka och ta emot försändelser.</P>
<P class="p724 ft2"><SPAN class="ft19">15 § </SPAN>Bestämmelserna i 7 kap. <NOBR>6–9</NOBR> §§ fängelselagen (2010:610) ska gälla vid tillfällig verkställighet av ett svenskt fängelsestraff i en kriminalvårdsanstalt utomlands enligt denna lag.</P>
<P class="p1158 ft2">392</P>
</DIV>
</DIV>
<DIV id="page_393">


<DIV id="id_1">
<DIV id="id_1_1">
<P class="p14 ft18">Personliga tillhörigheter</P>
<P class="p1159 ft2"><SPAN class="ft19">16 § </SPAN>En intagen vars svenska fängelsestraff tillfälligt verkställs i en kriminalvårdsanstalt utomlands enligt denna lag får ta emot och inneha de personliga tillhörigheter som Kriminalvården beslutar.</P>
<P class="p1160 ft2"><SPAN class="ft19">17 § </SPAN>Bestämmelserna i 5 kap. <NOBR>2–4</NOBR> §§ fängelselagen (2010:610) ska gälla vid tillfällig verkställighet av ett svenskt fängelsestraff i en kriminalvårdsanstalt utomlands enligt denna lag.</P>
<P class="p356 ft2">När den intagne ska svara för kostnader enligt 5 kap. 3 § fängelselagen får beloppet inte överstiga kostnaden för att sända tillhörigheterna från en kriminalvårdsanstalt i Sverige.</P>
</DIV>
<DIV id="id_1_2">
<P class="p14 ft2">Prop. 2025/26:185 Bilaga 4</P>
</DIV>
</DIV>
<DIV id="id_2">
<P class="p14 ft18">Intagnas medel</P>
<P class="p89 ft2"><SPAN class="ft19">18 § </SPAN>Kriminalvården ansvarar för administrationen av den intagnes medel under verkställigheten av ett svenskt fängelsestraff i en kriminalvårdsanstalt utomlands enligt denna lag.</P>
<P class="p85 ft2"><SPAN class="ft19">19 § </SPAN>Kriminalvården ska, för permissions- och frigivningsändamål, hålla inne en tiondel av den ersättning som betalas ut till en intagen för sysselsättning under verkställigheten av ett svenskt fängelsestraff i en kriminalvårdsanstalt utomlands enligt denna lag. Kriminalvården får i särskilda fall medge att den ersättning som hålls inne används för annat ändamål. Ersättning som hålls inne ska betalas ut till den intagne senast i samband med att han eller hon inte längre ska vara berövad friheten.</P>
<P class="p86 ft2"><SPAN class="ft19">20 § </SPAN>Om en intagen uppsåtligen har skadat egendom som tillhör eller har upplåtits till Kriminalvården, får Kriminalvården av den ersättning som betalas ut till den intagne för sysselsättning under verkställigheten av ett svenskt fängelsestraff i en kriminalvårdsanstalt utomlands enligt denna lag ta ut ett belopp som motsvarar kostnaderna för att ersätta eller på annat sätt återställa egendomen.</P>
<P class="p86 ft2"><SPAN class="ft19">21 § </SPAN>Ersättning som betalas ut till en intagen för sysselsättning under verkställigheten av ett svenskt fängelsestraff i en kriminalvårdsanstalt utomlands enligt denna lag får inte utmätas.</P>
<P class="p1161 ft18">Kontakter med advokater, andra rättsliga ombud eller <NOBR>icke-statliga</NOBR> organisationer som tillhandahåller juridiska tjänster</P>

<P class="p471 ft18">Upphörande av tillfällig verkställighet utomlands</P>
<P class="p521 ft2"><SPAN class="ft19">23 § </SPAN>En tillfällig verkställighet av ett svenskt fängelsestraff i en kriminalvårdsanstalt utomlands enligt denna lag ska upphöra senast vid den tidpunkt som anges i beslutet om framställning enligt 3 §. Sådan verkställighet upphör när den intagne anländer till Sverige.</P>
<P class="p748 ft2"><SPAN class="ft19">24 § </SPAN>Kriminalvården ska omedelbart besluta att en tillfällig verkställighet av ett svenskt fängelsestraff i en kriminalvårdsanstalt utomlands ska upphöra tidigare än vad som anges i beslutet om framställning enligt 3 §, om</P>
<P class="p1162 ft2"><SPAN class="ft2">1.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft20">något av kriterierna för när en framställning inte får göras enligt 6 § är uppfyllt,</SPAN></P>
<P class="p685 ft2"><SPAN class="ft2">2.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft20">myndigheten bedömer att det finns förutsättningar att bevilja permission eller särskild permission enligt 11 §,</SPAN></P>
<P class="p442 ft2"><SPAN class="ft2">3.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft20">den behöriga myndigheten i den mottagande staten har lämnat tillstånd till tillfällig vistelse utanför anstalt på begäran av en svensk domstol eller annan myndighet, eller</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1163 ft2"><SPAN class="ft2">4.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft20">den mottagande staten bedömer att den intagne utgör en allvarlig säkerhetsrisk.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p666 ft2">Ett sådant beslut ska även omedelbart fattas om en tillfällig verkställighet av ett svenskt fängelsestraff i en kriminalvårdsanstalt utomlands skulle</P>
<P class="p1163 ft2"><SPAN class="ft2">1.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft20">vara oförenlig med grundläggande principer för rättsordningen i Sverige, eller</SPAN></P>
<P class="p542 ft2"><SPAN class="ft2">2.</SPAN><SPAN class="ft23">strida mot Sveriges internationella förpliktelser.</SPAN></P>
<P class="p1164 ft2"><SPAN class="ft19">25 § </SPAN>Kriminalvården får även i andra fall än de som avses i 24 § besluta att en tillfällig verkställighet av ett svenskt fängelsestraff i en kriminalvårdsanstalt utomlands ska upphöra tidigare än vad som anges i beslutet om framställning enligt 3 §.</P>
<P class="p532 ft2">En intagen får begära att Kriminalvården fattar beslut enligt första stycket.</P>
<P class="p471 ft18">Överklagande</P>
<P class="p1150 ft2"><SPAN class="ft19">26 § </SPAN>Kriminalvårdens beslut enligt denna lag får överklagas till allmän förvaltningsdomstol.</P>
<TABLE cellpadding=0 cellspacing=0 class="t154">

	<TD class="tr26 td197"><P class="p17 ft6"> </P></TD>
	<TD class="tr26 td152"><P class="p138 ft2"><SPAN class="ft19">27 § </SPAN>Ett överklagande enligt 26 § ska göras till den förvaltningsrätt inom</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr18 td197"><P class="p17 ft37"> </P></TD>
	<TD class="tr18 td152"><P class="p138 ft22">vars domkrets den anstalt eller det häkte är beläget där den klagande var</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr5 td197"><P class="p17 ft6"> </P></TD>
	<TD class="tr5 td152"><P class="p138 ft2">inskriven när det första beslutet i ett ärende enligt denna lag fattades.</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr4 td197"><P class="p17 ft6"> </P></TD>
	<TD class="tr4 td152"><P class="p279 ft2">Om den klagande var inskriven i en kriminalvårdsanstalt utomlands när</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr4 td197"><P class="p17 ft6"> </P></TD>
	<TD class="tr4 td152"><P class="p138 ft2">det första beslutet i ärendet fattades, ska ett överklagande göras till den</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr5 td197"><P class="p17 ft6"> </P></TD>
	<TD class="tr5 td152"><P class="p138 ft2">förvaltningsrätt inom vars domkrets den anstalt eller det häkte är beläget</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr4 td197"><P class="p17 ft6"> </P></TD>
	<TD class="tr4 td152"><P class="p138 ft2">där den klagande senast var inskriven i Sverige.</P></TD>
</TR>
<TR>
	<TD class="tr2 td197"><P class="p137 ft2">394</P></TD>
	<TD class="tr2 td152"><P class="p279 ft2">Prövningstillstånd krävs vid överklagande till kammarrätten.</P></TD>
</TR>
